ancestry.title: Ancestry

meta.description: The Frame of Reference meta data section linking the named properties to self-contained definitions.
meta.title: Frame of Reference Meta Data

SampleIdentifier.title: Sample Identifier
SampleIdentifier.description: Identifier from a Master Data Management System or other trusted source external to OSDU - stored here in order to allow for multi-system connection and synchronization. If used, the "Source" property in AbstractCommonResources schema should identify that source system. i.e. this item is optional.

SampleName.title: Sample Name
SampleName.description: This provides the name of the sample. If there are other names that need to be stored , leverage the Aliases available in the Abstract objects.

SampleOriginTypeID.title: Sample Origin Type ID
SampleOriginTypeID.description: This provides information about the type of the origin of the sample. It can be used to determine if the sample was acquired from an original source location, result of recombination, subsampling or derived from some laboratory process.

SampleTypeID.title: Sample Type ID
SampleTypeID.description: The classification of the type of specimen/sample (e.g. whole core, cuttings, rock chip, oil extract, headspace gas), which is identified for the purpose of analysing the specimen or a subsample of it. In partnership with other reference data, the sample type may indicate the general substance type, size, shape, general source, and in certain cases, the retrieval method. In rare cases, the special purpose of a specimen might contribute to its sample type classification.

SampleDisposalInstructionID.title: Sample Disposition Instruction ID
SampleDisposalInstructionID.description: This is an OSDU Record ID referencing a document that contains instructions on how the sample should be disposed.

SampleAcquisition.title: Sample Acquisition
SampleAcquisition.description: This captures the acquisition parameters obtained during  the sample acquisition event associated with this sample. Note that this attribute should only be used when associating the sample with an acquisition event from its original source and not for sub-sampling or derivative sources.

SampleAcquisitionJobID.title: Sample Acquisition Job ID
SampleAcquisitionJobID.description: A reference to the parent record, which can group this sample acquisition event record with other sample acquisition event records, collected as part of the same job.

SampleAcquisitionDetail.title: Sample Acquisition Detail
SampleAcquisitionDetail.description: This attribute provides information about the acquisition parameters and process used in acquiring the target sample. Other information about the sample itself can be found in the Sample object.

VerticalMeasurement.title: Vertical Measurement
VerticalMeasurement.description: Information on the list of all depths and elevations pertaining to the target wellbore involved in the Sample Acquisition event, like, plug back measured depth, total measured depth, KB elevation. The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition

TopDepth.title: Top Depth
TopDepth.description:
The depth of the top of the target interval from which the sample was acquired. The reference and kind of depth (e.g. driller's depth versus logger's depth) is described in data.VerticalMeasurement. The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition.
Note: As an example, if ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
TopDepth=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.TopMD

BaseDepth.title: Base Depth
BaseDepth.description:
The depth of the base of the target interval from which the sample was acquired. The reference and kind of depth (e.g. driller's depth versus logger's depth) is described in data.VerticalMeasurement.  The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition.
Note: As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
TopDepth=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.BaseMD

ToolKind.title: Tool Kind
ToolKind.description:
This references the kind of tool used in acquiring the sample. The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FormationTestSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition.
Note: As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
ToolKind=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<DownholeSampleAcquisition>[].Item.ToolKind.

RunNumber.title: Run Number
RunNumber.description: This refers to the different runs performed during the sample acquisition event and is typically identified using integers. It mostly applies to acquisition events acquired from the subsurface like downhole, coring, etc. The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FormationTestSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition

WellboreID.title: Wellbore ID
WellboreID.description:
This refers to the OSDU record ID of the wellbore object from which the sample was acquired. It typically applies in scenarios where the acquisition event only pertains to a single wellbore object. The property is always used except with FacilitySampleAcquisition, Outcrop, SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note: If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
WellboreID= PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<DownholeSampleAcquisition | WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.Wellbore

WellheadOperatingCondition.title: Wellhead Operating Condition
WellheadOperatingCondition.description:
This captures the operating conditions (prevailing pressure and temperatures) on the target facility or equipment (in this case wellhead) during the sample acquisition event.  This attribute is provided in the event that the acquisition pressure and temperature recorded at the flow port or sampling point from which the sample is acquired is different from the operating P&T at the wellhead. The property is only used in conjunction with WellheadSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
wellheadOperatingCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.wellheadPressure
wellheadOperatingCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.wellheadTemperature

ContributingWellboreOpeningIDs.title: Contributing Wellbore Opening IDs
ContributingWellboreOpeningIDs.description:
This refers to an array of OSDU record IDs for the wellbore completion objects (perforated or open hole interval) that contributed to the stream used in acquiring the sample. It can be used for one wellbore opening or multiple opening in the case of commingled flow. This is typically related to acquisition events from downhole where samples are comingled from multiple completions. The property is only used in conjunction with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, DownholeSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
WellboreOpeningIDs[0]=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.WellboreCompletion

SeparatorOperatingCondition.title: Separator Operating Condition
SeparatorOperatingCondition.description:
This captures the operating conditions (prevailing pressure and temperatures) on the target facility or equipment (in this case separator) during the sample acquisition event.  This attribute is provided in the event that the acquisition pressure and temperature recorded at the flow port or sampling point from which the sample is acquired is different from the operating P&T for the separator. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
SeparatorOperatingCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.SeparatorPressure
SeparatorOperatingCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.SeparatorTemperature

SamplingPoint.title: Sampling Point
SamplingPoint.description:
A free-form reference to the flow port on the Facility where this sample was acquired. The property is only used in conjunction with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
SamplingPoint= [ PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition | FacilitySampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.SamplingPoint

SamplingPointTypeID.title: Sampling Point Type ID
SamplingPointTypeID.description: This is the OSDU record ID from a reference list containing the different types of sampling points.

SamplingPointName.title: Sampling Point Name
SamplingPointName.description: This is a description of the name of the  component or equipment used in capturing the sample. It can be used in storing the P & ID of the equipment or its component as defined within the Organisations Facility SOR / Repository.

CorrectedOilRate.title: Corrected Oil Rate
CorrectedOilRate.description:
The value accounts for the application of correction procedures to the oil flow rate observed / measured during the sample acquisition event. The property is typically only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
CorrectedOilRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.CorrectedOilRate

CorrectedGasRate.title: Corrected Gas Rate
CorrectedGasRate.description:
The value accounts for the application of correction procedures to the gas flow rate observed / measured during the sample acquisition event. The property is typically only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
CorrectedGasRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.CorrectedGasRate

CorrectedWaterRate.title: Corrected Water Rate
CorrectedWaterRate.description:
The value accounts for the application of correction procedures to the water flow rate observed / measured during the sample acquisition event. The property is typically only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
CorrectedWaterRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.CorrectedWaterRate

MeasuredOilRate.title: Measured Oil Rate
MeasuredOilRate.description:
This is the  observed/ measured oil rate for this sample acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
MeasuredOilRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.MeasuredOilRate

MeasuredGasRate.title: Measured Gas Rate
MeasuredGasRate.description:
This is the observed/ measured gas rate for this sample acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
MeasuredGasRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.MeasuredGasRate

MeasuredWaterRate.title: Measured Water Rate
MeasuredWaterRate.description:
This is the observed/ measured water rate for this sample acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
MeasuredWaterRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.MeasuredWaterRate

FormationCondition.title: Formation Condition
FormationCondition.description:
This captures the operating conditions (prevailing pressure and temperatures) on the target formation during the sample acquisition event.  This attribute is provided in the event that the acquisition pressure and temperature recorded at the downhole sampling location is different from the Formation's P&T. The property is used in conjunction with all the acquisition event types except FacilitySampleAcquisition, Cuttings and  WellheadSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
FormationCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.FormationPressure
FormationCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.FormationTemperature

CorrectionRemarks.title: Correction Remarks
CorrectionRemarks.description: This is used to capture information regarding the methodology used in correcting rates acquired during the sample acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition

SampleCarrierSlotName.title: Sample Carrier Slot Name
SampleCarrierSlotName.description:
The name or identifier for the slot in the sample carrier where the sample was acquired. The property is only used in conjunction with FormationTestSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
SampleCarrierSlotName=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.SampleCarrierSlotName

ToolSectionName.title: Tool Section Name
ToolSectionName.description:
The name of the formation tester tool section that was used in acquiring the sample. The property is only used in conjunction with FormationTestSampleAcquisition, ConventionalCore, Sidewall Core, Cuttings
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
ToolSectionName=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.ToolSectionName

SampleContainerCushionPressure.title: Cushion Pressure
SampleContainerCushionPressure.description:
The pressure used in charging the sample container. The property is only used in conjunction with FormationTestSampleAcquisition
Note: As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
SampleContainerCushionPressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.CushionPressure

GrossFluidKindID.title: Gross Fluid Kind
GrossFluidKindID.description:
This is the OSDU record ID for the predominant fluid kind obtained from the formation during the acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with FormationTestSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below: 
GrossFluidKind=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.GrossFluidKind

FacilityEquipmentOperatingCondition.title: Facility Equipment operating Condition
FacilityEquipmentOperatingCondition.description:
This captures the operating conditions (prevailing pressure and temperatures) on the target equipment used on Topside Facilities (exclusive of wells or separators) during the sample acquisition event.  This attribute is provided in the event that the acquisition pressure and temperature recorded at the flow port or sampling point from which the sample is acquired is different from the operating P&T for the target facility or equipment. The property is only used in conjunction with FacilitySampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
FacilityOperatingCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition>[].Item.FacilityPressure
FacilityOperatingCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition>[].Item.FacilityTemperature

SiteID.title: Site ID
SiteID.description: Identifies the type of non-facility location (e.g. beach, oil seep, outcrop, sinkhole) that can be where the acquisition event occurred to collect a rock or fluid sample. Being different from a facility (which includes wells), a generic site is usually a natural location, not a man-made structure or a grouping of equipment.

SampleRecoveredLengthActual.title: Sample Recovered Length Actual
SampleRecoveredLengthActual.description: Actual length of recovered sample, usually a core The property is only used in conjunction with ConventionalCore, Sidewall Core, Outcrop

PreservationTypeID.title: Preservation Type ID
PreservationTypeID.description: The kind of preservation applied to this sample if applied at the time of acquisition. The property is only used in conjunction with ConventionalCore, Sidewall Core, Cuttings, Outcrop, Core Plugs

SampleRecoveredLengthPlanned.title: Sample Recovered Length Planned
SampleRecoveredLengthPlanned.description: Planned length of sample to be recovered, usually a core The property is only used in conjunction with ConventionalCore, Sidewall Core, Cuttings, Outcrop

AcquisitionCondition.title: Acquisition Condition
AcquisitionCondition.description:
This captures the prevailing pressure and temperature recorded at the sampling point during the sample acquisition event. The property applies to ALL sampling acquisition events.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
AcquisitionCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition|DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationSampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition | WellheadSampleAcquisition >[].Item.AcquisitionPressure
AcquisitionCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition|DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationSampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition | WellheadSampleAcquisition >[].Item.AcquisitionTemperature

AcquisitionGOR.title: Acquisition GOR
AcquisitionGOR.description:
This captures the gas oil ratio (GOR) for the sample acquired during the sample acquisition event. The property applies to ALL FLUID sampling acquisition events.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
AcquisitionGOR=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition|DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationSampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition | WellheadSampleAcquisition >[].Item.AcquisitionGOR

MudBaseTypeID.title: Mud Base Type ID
MudBaseTypeID.description: Identifies the type of fluid in the wellbore annulus used during the acquisition event or present in the sample required.

MudTracerTypeID.title: Mud Tracer Type ID
MudTracerTypeID.description: Identifies the type of tracer used during the sample acquisition event.

AcquisitionToolFamilyID.description: Identifies the category of the tool type used to acquire the sample/specimen, such as rotary or percussive sidewall tooling, or the inner barrel type for conventional coring. Note that other relevant facets of tool identification are captured by other reference lists, such as core catcher type, inner sleeve material type, drill bit, and sample container.

ConventionalCoreInnerSleeveMaterialID.description: Identifies the category of material of the cylindrical sleeve that lines the inside of the inner core barrel during coring operations.

ConventionalCoreCatcherTypeID.description: Identifies the category of the core catcher used in core acquisition. A core catcher is a device located in the core barrel of drilling tools that securely retains the core sample during its extraction from the subsurface.

WasCryogenicallyAcquired.description: Indicates whether the rock was cryogenically frozen when it was acquired. In this process, the drilling fluid is pushed aside from the coring zone, liquid nitrogen or similar cryogenic agent is injected through a specialized cryogenic coring tool, and then a core barrel retrieves the stabilized core sample.

IsCommingledProductionFluid.description: Indicates whether the fluid sample consists of fluids from multiple reservoir zones and/or wellbore openings mixed into one production flow stream before being collected.

SampleAcquisitionTypeID.title: Sample Acquisition Type ID
SampleAcquisitionTypeID.description: This is a reference list of the different types of sample acquisition events used in acquiring samples. i.e. downhole sample acquisition type, outcrop, coring, non-facility site, etc

SampleAcquisitionContainerID.title: Sample Acquisition Container ID
SampleAcquisitionContainerID.description: This is the OSDU Record ID for the original sample container used in the acquired sample. This is only for the initial sample acquisition. Only populate this for the original sample.

AcquisitionStartDate.title: Acquisition Start Date
AcquisitionStartDate.description: The start date and time of the acquisition event.

AcquisitionEndDate.title: Acquisition End Date
AcquisitionEndDate.description: The end date and time of the acquisition event.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: A remark object, pairing a remark text with a source, e.g. an author, and a date, which is typically included in an array.

CollectionServiceCompanyID.title: Collection Service Company ID
CollectionServiceCompanyID.description: The company that managed the collection of the sample from its original / source environment.

HandlingServiceCompanyID.title: Handling Service Company ID
HandlingServiceCompanyID.description: The company that handled the sample on site after the it was collected/extracted. For example, the company that applied field preservation methods, and prepared the sample for shipping.

SampleProperties.title: Sample Properties
SampleProperties.description: This captures information pertaining to the observed physical properties of the sample.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: An array containing operational or quality comments about the sample.

RecombinationSpecification.title: Recombination Specification
RecombinationSpecification.description: For a sample that has been recombined from separate samples, e.g. liquid sample and vapor sample, this object records the specified: recombination conditions (pressure and temperature), recombination ratio, the saturation pressure and  target recombined sample composition, whichever of these are appropriate for this recombination effort.

RecombinationCondition.title: Recombination Condition
RecombinationCondition.description: The prevailing operating conditions (Pressure and Temperature)  for the recombination operation.

RecombinationGasOilRatio.title: Recombination Gas Oil Ratio
RecombinationGasOilRatio.description: The gas-oil ratio recorded for this sample recombination process as well as the volumetric reference conditions for both the oil and gas phases. This is typically required for fluid sample types.

GasOilRatio.description: The Gas Oil Ratio calculated at the reference conditions specified for each stream (Oil or Gas)

VolumeReferenceConditionGas.description: The pressure and temperature reference values for the gas stream.

VolumeReferenceConditionOil.description: The pressure and temperature reference values for the oil stream.

RecombinationSaturationPressure.title: Recombination Saturation Pressure
RecombinationSaturationPressure.description: The observed saturation pressure for this sample recombination process. Mostly applies to fluid samples.

TargetSampleComposition.title: Target Sample Composition
TargetSampleComposition.description: This provides an array of components and their fraction contribution to the overall expected composition of the  sample generated by the recombination process. This is typically required for fluid sample types.

items.title: Component Fraction
items.description: This object holds information about a sample or component of a sample and its contribution to a target sample created through the recombination process.

SampleCompositionComponentID.title: Sample Composition Component ID
SampleCompositionComponentID.description: This is the OSDU Record ID of an item in the list of  sample components. This attribute references the components that make up a sample.

VolumeFraction.title: Volume Fraction
VolumeFraction.description: The volume fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.

MassFraction.title: Mass Fraction
MassFraction.description: The mass fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.

MoleFraction.title: Mole Fraction
MoleFraction.description: The mole fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.
MoleFraction.x-osdu-frame-of-reference: UOM:amount of substance per amount of substance

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: Pertinent information about the sample recombination specification stored alongside the other attributes.

RecombinedSampleFraction.title: Recombined Sample Fraction
RecombinedSampleFraction.description: Object capturing the mixture and contributions from multiple samples.

items.title: Component Fraction
items.description: This object holds information about a sample or component of a sample and its contribution to a target sample created through the recombination process.

SampleCompositionComponentID.title: Sample Composition Component ID
SampleCompositionComponentID.description: This is the OSDU Record ID of an item in the list of  sample components. This attribute references the components that make up a sample.

VolumeFraction.title: Volume Fraction
VolumeFraction.description: The volume fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.

MassFraction.title: Mass Fraction
MassFraction.description: The mass fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.

MoleFraction.title: Mole Fraction
MoleFraction.description: The mole fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.
MoleFraction.x-osdu-frame-of-reference: UOM:amount of substance per amount of substance

ParentSampleIDs.title: Parent Sample IDs
ParentSampleIDs.description: This attribute stores the array of OSDU record IDs for the parent samples used in creating this sample. Creation of this sample could be achieved through through extractions, sub sampling, derived sampling or recombination.

SamplePreparation.title: Sample Preparation
SamplePreparation.description: This captures information about the preparation process executed after the sample acquisition event.

items.title: Sample Preparation
items.description: This captures information about the preparation process executed after the sample acquisition event.

SamplePreparationTypeID.title: Sample Preparation Type IDs
SamplePreparationTypeID.description: Provides extra details on any processes applied after the sample has been acquired

SamplePreparationMethodID.title: Sample Preparation Method IDs
SamplePreparationMethodID.description: Provide additional details on which industrial/lab method used to conduct the sample preparation

SamplePreparationCondition.title: Sample Preparation Condition
SamplePreparationCondition.description: Used to describe the pressure and temperature conditions at which the sample preparation took place

SamplePreparationStartDate.title: Sample Preparation Start Date
SamplePreparationStartDate.description: This represents the start date for the sample preparation process.

SamplePreparationEndDate.title: Sample Preparation End Date
SamplePreparationEndDate.description: This represents the end date for the sample preparation process.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: This captures other pertinent information regarding the sample preparation process.

/data/Generated/master-data/Sample.3.1.0.title: Sample
/data/Generated/master-data/Sample.3.1.0.description: This object captures attributes of a sample or specimen (rocks, fluids, or other materials) acquired either through an original acquisition event, sub-sampling event, generated from recombination of other samples or specimens or derived through the application of some laboratory process on the parent sample.

id.description: Previously called ResourceID or SRN which identifies this OSDU resource object without version.
id.title: Entity ID

kind.description: The schema identification for the OSDU resource object following the pattern {Namespace}:{Source}:{Type}:{VersionMajor}.{VersionMinor}.{VersionPatch}. The versioning scheme follows the semantic versioning, https://semver.org/.
kind.title: Entity Kind

version.description: The version number of this OSDU resource; set by the framework.
version.title: Version Number

acl.description: The access control tags associated with this entity.
acl.title: Access Control List

legal.description: The entity's legal tags and compliance status. The actual contents associated with the legal tags is managed by the Compliance Service.
legal.title: Legal Tags

tags.title: Tag Dictionary
tags.description: A generic dictionary of string keys mapping to string value. Only strings are permitted as keys and values.

createTime.description: Timestamp of the time at which initial version of this OSDU resource object was created. Set by the System. The value is a combined date-time string in ISO-8601 given in UTC.
createTime.title: Resource Object Creation DateTime

createUser.title: Resource Object Creation User Reference
createUser.description: The user reference, which created the first version of this resource object. Set by the System.

modifyTime.description: Timestamp of the time at which this version of the OSDU resource object was created. Set by the System. The value is a combined date-time string in ISO-8601 given in UTC.
modifyTime.title: Resource Object Version Creation DateTime

modifyUser.title: Resource Object Version Creation User Reference
modifyUser.description: The user reference, which created this version of this resource object. Set by the System.

ancestry.description: The links to data, which constitute the inputs, from which this record instance is derived.
ancestry.title: Ancestry

meta.description: The Frame of Reference meta data section linking the named properties to self-contained definitions.
meta.title: Frame of Reference Meta Data

SampleIdentifier.title: Sample Identifier
SampleIdentifier.description: Identifier from a Master Data Management System or other trusted source external to OSDU - stored here in order to allow for multi-system connection and synchronization. If used, the "Source" property in AbstractCommonResources schema should identify that source system. i.e. this item is optional.

SampleName.title: Sample Name
SampleName.description: This provides the name of the sample. If there are other names that need to be stored , leverage the Aliases available in the Abstract objects.

SampleOriginTypeID.title: Sample Origin Type ID
SampleOriginTypeID.description: This provides information about the type of the origin of the sample. It can be used to determine if the sample was acquired from an original source location, result of recombination, subsampling or derived from some laboratory process.

SampleTypeID.title: Sample Type ID
SampleTypeID.description: The classification of the type of specimen/sample (e.g. whole core, cuttings, rock chip, oil extract, headspace gas), which is identified for the purpose of analysing the specimen or a subsample of it. In partnership with other reference data, the sample type may indicate the general substance type, size, shape, general source, and in certain cases, the retrieval method. In rare cases, the special purpose of a specimen might contribute to its sample type classification.

SampleDisposalInstructionID.title: Sample Disposition Instruction ID
SampleDisposalInstructionID.description: This is an OSDU Record ID referencing a document that contains instructions on how the sample should be disposed.

SampleAcquisition.title: Sample Acquisition
SampleAcquisition.description: This captures the acquisition parameters obtained during  the sample acquisition event associated with this sample. Note that this attribute should only be used when associating the sample with an acquisition event from its original source and not for sub-sampling or derivative sources.

SampleAcquisitionJobID.title: Sample Acquisition Job ID
SampleAcquisitionJobID.description: A reference to the parent record, which can group this sample acquisition event record with other sample acquisition event records, collected as part of the same job.

SampleAcquisitionDetail.title: Sample Acquisition Detail
SampleAcquisitionDetail.description: This attribute provides information about the acquisition parameters and process used in acquiring the target sample. Other information about the sample itself can be found in the Sample object.

VerticalMeasurement.title: Vertical Measurement
VerticalMeasurement.description: Information on the list of all depths and elevations pertaining to the target wellbore involved in the Sample Acquisition event, like, plug back measured depth, total measured depth, KB elevation. The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition

TopDepth.title: Top Depth
TopDepth.description:
The depth of the top of the target interval from which the sample was acquired. The reference and kind of depth (e.g. driller's depth versus logger's depth) is described in data.VerticalMeasurement. The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition.
Note: As an example, if ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
TopDepth=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.TopMD

BaseDepth.title: Base Depth
BaseDepth.description:
The depth of the base of the target interval from which the sample was acquired. The reference and kind of depth (e.g. driller's depth versus logger's depth) is described in data.VerticalMeasurement.  The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition.
Note: As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
TopDepth=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.BaseMD

ToolKind.title: Tool Kind
ToolKind.description:
This references the kind of tool used in acquiring the sample. The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FormationTestSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition.
Note: As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
ToolKind=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<DownholeSampleAcquisition>[].Item.ToolKind.

RunNumber.title: Run Number
RunNumber.description: This refers to the different runs performed during the sample acquisition event and is typically identified using integers. It mostly applies to acquisition events acquired from the subsurface like downhole, coring, etc. The property is always used except with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FormationTestSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition

WellboreID.title: Wellbore ID
WellboreID.description:
This refers to the OSDU record ID of the wellbore object from which the sample was acquired. It typically applies in scenarios where the acquisition event only pertains to a single wellbore object. The property is always used except with FacilitySampleAcquisition, Outcrop, SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note: If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
WellboreID= PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<DownholeSampleAcquisition | WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.Wellbore

WellheadOperatingCondition.title: Wellhead Operating Condition
WellheadOperatingCondition.description:
This captures the operating conditions (prevailing pressure and temperatures) on the target facility or equipment (in this case wellhead) during the sample acquisition event.  This attribute is provided in the event that the acquisition pressure and temperature recorded at the flow port or sampling point from which the sample is acquired is different from the operating P&T at the wellhead. The property is only used in conjunction with WellheadSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
wellheadOperatingCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.wellheadPressure
wellheadOperatingCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.wellheadTemperature

ContributingWellboreOpeningIDs.title: Contributing Wellbore Opening IDs
ContributingWellboreOpeningIDs.description:
This refers to an array of OSDU record IDs for the wellbore completion objects (perforated or open hole interval) that contributed to the stream used in acquiring the sample. It can be used for one wellbore opening or multiple opening in the case of commingled flow. This is typically related to acquisition events from downhole where samples are comingled from multiple completions. The property is only used in conjunction with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, DownholeSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
WellboreOpeningIDs[0]=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.WellboreCompletion

SeparatorOperatingCondition.title: Separator Operating Condition
SeparatorOperatingCondition.description:
This captures the operating conditions (prevailing pressure and temperatures) on the target facility or equipment (in this case separator) during the sample acquisition event.  This attribute is provided in the event that the acquisition pressure and temperature recorded at the flow port or sampling point from which the sample is acquired is different from the operating P&T for the separator. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
SeparatorOperatingCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.SeparatorPressure
SeparatorOperatingCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.SeparatorTemperature

SamplingPoint.title: Sampling Point
SamplingPoint.description:
A free-form reference to the flow port on the Facility where this sample was acquired. The property is only used in conjunction with WellheadSampleAcquisition, SeparatorSampleAcquisition, FacilitySampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
SamplingPoint= [ PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition | FacilitySampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.SamplingPoint

SamplingPointTypeID.title: Sampling Point Type ID
SamplingPointTypeID.description: This is the OSDU record ID from a reference list containing the different types of sampling points.

SamplingPointName.title: Sampling Point Name
SamplingPointName.description: This is a description of the name of the  component or equipment used in capturing the sample. It can be used in storing the P & ID of the equipment or its component as defined within the Organisations Facility SOR / Repository.

CorrectedOilRate.title: Corrected Oil Rate
CorrectedOilRate.description:
The value accounts for the application of correction procedures to the oil flow rate observed / measured during the sample acquisition event. The property is typically only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
CorrectedOilRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.CorrectedOilRate

CorrectedGasRate.title: Corrected Gas Rate
CorrectedGasRate.description:
The value accounts for the application of correction procedures to the gas flow rate observed / measured during the sample acquisition event. The property is typically only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
CorrectedGasRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.CorrectedGasRate

CorrectedWaterRate.title: Corrected Water Rate
CorrectedWaterRate.description:
The value accounts for the application of correction procedures to the water flow rate observed / measured during the sample acquisition event. The property is typically only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
CorrectedWaterRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.CorrectedWaterRate

MeasuredOilRate.title: Measured Oil Rate
MeasuredOilRate.description:
This is the  observed/ measured oil rate for this sample acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
MeasuredOilRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.MeasuredOilRate

MeasuredGasRate.title: Measured Gas Rate
MeasuredGasRate.description:
This is the observed/ measured gas rate for this sample acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
MeasuredGasRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.MeasuredGasRate

MeasuredWaterRate.title: Measured Water Rate
MeasuredWaterRate.description:
This is the observed/ measured water rate for this sample acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
MeasuredWaterRate=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<SeparatorSampleAcquisition>[].Item.MeasuredWaterRate

FormationCondition.title: Formation Condition
FormationCondition.description:
This captures the operating conditions (prevailing pressure and temperatures) on the target formation during the sample acquisition event.  This attribute is provided in the event that the acquisition pressure and temperature recorded at the downhole sampling location is different from the Formation's P&T. The property is used in conjunction with all the acquisition event types except FacilitySampleAcquisition, Cuttings and  WellheadSampleAcquisition.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
FormationCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.FormationPressure
FormationCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<WellheadSampleAcquisition>[].Item.FormationTemperature

CorrectionRemarks.title: Correction Remarks
CorrectionRemarks.description: This is used to capture information regarding the methodology used in correcting rates acquired during the sample acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with SeparatorSampleAcquisition

SampleCarrierSlotName.title: Sample Carrier Slot Name
SampleCarrierSlotName.description:
The name or identifier for the slot in the sample carrier where the sample was acquired. The property is only used in conjunction with FormationTestSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
SampleCarrierSlotName=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.SampleCarrierSlotName

ToolSectionName.title: Tool Section Name
ToolSectionName.description:
The name of the formation tester tool section that was used in acquiring the sample. The property is only used in conjunction with FormationTestSampleAcquisition, ConventionalCore, Sidewall Core, Cuttings
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
ToolSectionName=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.ToolSectionName

SampleContainerCushionPressure.title: Cushion Pressure
SampleContainerCushionPressure.description:
The pressure used in charging the sample container. The property is only used in conjunction with FormationTestSampleAcquisition
Note: As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
SampleContainerCushionPressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.CushionPressure

GrossFluidKindID.title: Gross Fluid Kind
GrossFluidKindID.description:
This is the OSDU record ID for the predominant fluid kind obtained from the formation during the acquisition event. The property is only used in conjunction with FormationTestSampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below: 
GrossFluidKind=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FormationTestSampleAcquisition>[].Item.GrossFluidKind

FacilityEquipmentOperatingCondition.title: Facility Equipment operating Condition
FacilityEquipmentOperatingCondition.description:
This captures the operating conditions (prevailing pressure and temperatures) on the target equipment used on Topside Facilities (exclusive of wells or separators) during the sample acquisition event.  This attribute is provided in the event that the acquisition pressure and temperature recorded at the flow port or sampling point from which the sample is acquired is different from the operating P&T for the target facility or equipment. The property is only used in conjunction with FacilitySampleAcquisition
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
FacilityOperatingCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition>[].Item.FacilityPressure
FacilityOperatingCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition>[].Item.FacilityTemperature

SiteID.title: Site ID
SiteID.description: Identifies the type of non-facility location (e.g. beach, oil seep, outcrop, sinkhole) that can be where the acquisition event occurred to collect a rock or fluid sample. Being different from a facility (which includes wells), a generic site is usually a natural location, not a man-made structure or a grouping of equipment.

SampleRecoveredLengthActual.title: Sample Recovered Length Actual
SampleRecoveredLengthActual.description: Actual length of recovered sample, usually a core The property is only used in conjunction with ConventionalCore, Sidewall Core, Outcrop

PreservationTypeID.title: Preservation Type ID
PreservationTypeID.description: The kind of preservation applied to this sample if applied at the time of acquisition. The property is only used in conjunction with ConventionalCore, Sidewall Core, Cuttings, Outcrop, Core Plugs

SampleRecoveredLengthPlanned.title: Sample Recovered Length Planned
SampleRecoveredLengthPlanned.description: Planned length of sample to be recovered, usually a core The property is only used in conjunction with ConventionalCore, Sidewall Core, Cuttings, Outcrop

AcquisitionCondition.title: Acquisition Condition
AcquisitionCondition.description:
This captures the prevailing pressure and temperature recorded at the sampling point during the sample acquisition event. The property applies to ALL sampling acquisition events.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
AcquisitionCondition.Pressure=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition|DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationSampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition | WellheadSampleAcquisition >[].Item.AcquisitionPressure
AcquisitionCondition.Temperature=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition|DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationSampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition | WellheadSampleAcquisition >[].Item.AcquisitionTemperature

AcquisitionGOR.title: Acquisition GOR
AcquisitionGOR.description:
This captures the gas oil ratio (GOR) for the sample acquired during the sample acquisition event. The property applies to ALL FLUID sampling acquisition events.
Note:As an example, If ingesting data formatted using PRODML, this is typically  mapped as seen below:
AcquisitionGOR=PRODML:2.1:FluidSampleAcquisitionJob.FluidSampleAcquisition<FacilitySampleAcquisition|DownholeSampleAcquisition | FormationSampleAcquisition | SeparatorSampleAcquisition | WellheadSampleAcquisition >[].Item.AcquisitionGOR

MudBaseTypeID.title: Mud Base Type ID
MudBaseTypeID.description: Identifies the type of fluid in the wellbore annulus used during the acquisition event or present in the sample required.

MudTracerTypeID.title: Mud Tracer Type ID
MudTracerTypeID.description: Identifies the type of tracer used during the sample acquisition event.

AcquisitionToolFamilyID.description: Identifies the category of the tool type used to acquire the sample/specimen, such as rotary or percussive sidewall tooling, or the inner barrel type for conventional coring. Note that other relevant facets of tool identification are captured by other reference lists, such as core catcher type, inner sleeve material type, drill bit, and sample container.

ConventionalCoreInnerSleeveMaterialID.description: Identifies the category of material of the cylindrical sleeve that lines the inside of the inner core barrel during coring operations.

ConventionalCoreCatcherTypeID.description: Identifies the category of the core catcher used in core acquisition. A core catcher is a device located in the core barrel of drilling tools that securely retains the core sample during its extraction from the subsurface.

WasCryogenicallyAcquired.description: Indicates whether the rock was cryogenically frozen when it was acquired. In this process, the drilling fluid is pushed aside from the coring zone, liquid nitrogen or similar cryogenic agent is injected through a specialized cryogenic coring tool, and then a core barrel retrieves the stabilized core sample.

IsCommingledProductionFluid.description: Indicates whether the fluid sample consists of fluids from multiple reservoir zones and/or wellbore openings mixed into one production flow stream before being collected.

SampleAcquisitionTypeID.title: Sample Acquisition Type ID
SampleAcquisitionTypeID.description: This is a reference list of the different types of sample acquisition events used in acquiring samples. i.e. downhole sample acquisition type, outcrop, coring, non-facility site, etc

SampleAcquisitionContainerID.title: Sample Acquisition Container ID
SampleAcquisitionContainerID.description: This is the OSDU Record ID for the original sample container used in the acquired sample. This is only for the initial sample acquisition. Only populate this for the original sample.

AcquisitionStartDate.title: Acquisition Start Date
AcquisitionStartDate.description: The start date and time of the acquisition event.

AcquisitionEndDate.title: Acquisition End Date
AcquisitionEndDate.description: The end date and time of the acquisition event.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: A remark object, pairing a remark text with a source, e.g. an author, and a date, which is typically included in an array.

CollectionServiceCompanyID.title: Collection Service Company ID
CollectionServiceCompanyID.description: The company that managed the collection of the sample from its original / source environment.

HandlingServiceCompanyID.title: Handling Service Company ID
HandlingServiceCompanyID.description: The company that handled the sample on site after the it was collected/extracted. For example, the company that applied field preservation methods, and prepared the sample for shipping.

SampleProperties.title: Sample Properties
SampleProperties.description: This captures information pertaining to the observed physical properties of the sample.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: An array containing operational or quality comments about the sample.

RecombinationSpecification.title: Recombination Specification
RecombinationSpecification.description: For a sample that has been recombined from separate samples, e.g. liquid sample and vapor sample, this object records the specified: recombination conditions (pressure and temperature), recombination ratio, the saturation pressure and  target recombined sample composition, whichever of these are appropriate for this recombination effort.

RecombinationCondition.title: Recombination Condition
RecombinationCondition.description: The prevailing operating conditions (Pressure and Temperature)  for the recombination operation.

RecombinationGasOilRatio.title: Recombination Gas Oil Ratio
RecombinationGasOilRatio.description: The gas-oil ratio recorded for this sample recombination process as well as the volumetric reference conditions for both the oil and gas phases. This is typically required for fluid sample types.

GasOilRatio.description: The Gas Oil Ratio calculated at the reference conditions specified for each stream (Oil or Gas)

VolumeReferenceConditionGas.description: The pressure and temperature reference values for the gas stream.

VolumeReferenceConditionOil.description: The pressure and temperature reference values for the oil stream.

RecombinationSaturationPressure.title: Recombination Saturation Pressure
RecombinationSaturationPressure.description: The observed saturation pressure for this sample recombination process. Mostly applies to fluid samples.

TargetSampleComposition.title: Target Sample Composition
TargetSampleComposition.description: This provides an array of components and their fraction contribution to the overall expected composition of the  sample generated by the recombination process. This is typically required for fluid sample types.

items.title: Component Fraction
items.description: This object holds information about a sample or component of a sample and its contribution to a target sample created through the recombination process.

SampleCompositionComponentID.title: Sample Composition Component ID
SampleCompositionComponentID.description: This is the OSDU Record ID of an item in the list of  sample components. This attribute references the components that make up a sample.

VolumeFraction.title: Volume Fraction
VolumeFraction.description: The volume fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.

MassFraction.title: Mass Fraction
MassFraction.description: The mass fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.

MoleFraction.title: Mole Fraction
MoleFraction.description: The mole fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.
MoleFraction.x-osdu-frame-of-reference: UOM:amount of substance per amount of substance

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: Pertinent information about the sample recombination specification stored alongside the other attributes.

RecombinedSampleFraction.title: Recombined Sample Fraction
RecombinedSampleFraction.description: Object capturing the mixture and contributions from multiple samples.

items.title: Component Fraction
items.description: This object holds information about a sample or component of a sample and its contribution to a target sample created through the recombination process.

SampleCompositionComponentID.title: Sample Composition Component ID
SampleCompositionComponentID.description: This is the OSDU Record ID of an item in the list of  sample components. This attribute references the components that make up a sample.

VolumeFraction.title: Volume Fraction
VolumeFraction.description: The volume fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.

MassFraction.title: Mass Fraction
MassFraction.description: The mass fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.

MoleFraction.title: Mole Fraction
MoleFraction.description: The mole fraction contribution of this component to the sample composition.
MoleFraction.x-osdu-frame-of-reference: UOM:amount of substance per amount of substance

ParentSampleIDs.title: Parent Sample IDs
ParentSampleIDs.description: This attribute stores the array of OSDU record IDs for the parent samples used in creating this sample. Creation of this sample could be achieved through through extractions, sub sampling, derived sampling or recombination.

SamplePreparation.title: Sample Preparation
SamplePreparation.description: This captures information about the preparation process executed after the sample acquisition event.

items.title: Sample Preparation
items.description: This captures information about the preparation process executed after the sample acquisition event.

SamplePreparationTypeID.title: Sample Preparation Type IDs
SamplePreparationTypeID.description: Provides extra details on any processes applied after the sample has been acquired

SamplePreparationMethodID.title: Sample Preparation Method IDs
SamplePreparationMethodID.description: Provide additional details on which industrial/lab method used to conduct the sample preparation

SamplePreparationCondition.title: Sample Preparation Condition
SamplePreparationCondition.description: Used to describe the pressure and temperature conditions at which the sample preparation took place

SamplePreparationStartDate.title: Sample Preparation Start Date
SamplePreparationStartDate.description: This represents the start date for the sample preparation process.

SamplePreparationEndDate.title: Sample Preparation End Date
SamplePreparationEndDate.description: This represents the end date for the sample preparation process.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: This captures other pertinent information regarding the sample preparation process.

DepthMeasurements.title: Depth Measurements
DepthMeasurements.description: All depths and elevations pertaining to the target sample or sub-sample, e.g., top and base measured depths, top and base true vertical depths, measured depth elevation.

DefinitiveDepthShift.title: Definitive Depth Shift
DefinitiveDepthShift.description: Specification of the depth shift for this sample that is considered definitive by the organization, business unit, or owner.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name of this 'chain of custody' event.

TransferCondition.title: Transfer Condition
TransferCondition.description:
The pressure and temperature conditions recorded during the sample transfer operation between containers for the current chain of custody event.
Eg. if ingesting from PRODML Sample object, then the mapping can be seen below:
TransferCondition.Pressure = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].TransferPressure
TransferCondition.Temperature = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].TransferTemperature

OpeningCondition.title: Opening Condition
OpeningCondition.description: The pressure and temperature conditions recorded when the previous sample container is opened for the current chain of custody event.

ClosingCondition.title: Closing Condition
ClosingCondition.description: The pressure and temperature conditions recorded when the current sample container is closed for the current chain of custody event.

InitialSampleProperties.title: Initial Sample Properties
InitialSampleProperties.description: The initial sample properties observed in the source container at the start of this chain of custody event.

RemainingSampleProperties.title: Remaining Sample Properties
RemainingSampleProperties.description: The remaining sample properties observed in the target container at the end of this chain of custody event.

LostSampleProperties.title: Lost Sample Properties
LostSampleProperties.description: The difference in sample properties observed due to losses incurred while transferring between containers during this chain of custody event.

CustodyDate.title: Date of the Change of Custody Event
CustodyDate.description:
Date for this chain of custody event
Reference: 
CustodyDate = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].CustodyDate

CustodyEventTypeID.title: Type of Chain of Custody Action
CustodyEventTypeID.description:
The action for this chain of custody event. Enum. See sample action.
Reference: 
CustodyActionID = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].CustodyAction

Custodian.title: Custodian
Custodian.description:
The custodian responsible for this change of custody event
Reference: 
Custodian = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].Custodian

PreviousStorageLocation.title: Initial Storage Location
PreviousStorageLocation.description: The initial physical location where this sample was stored at the start of the chain of custody event.

CurrentStorageLocation.title: Final Storage Location
CurrentStorageLocation.description: The location where the sample was stored at the end of the chain of custody event

CustodyEventLocationID.title: Custody Event Location ID
CustodyEventLocationID.description:
The physical location or organisation where this chain of custody event occurred.
Eg. if ingesting from PRODML Sample object, then the mapping can be seen below: 
CustodyEventLocation = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].ContainerLocation

PreviousContainerID.title: Previous Container ID
PreviousContainerID.description:
The OSDU record ID of the previous container used to hold the sample at the start of the chain of custody event.
Eg. if ingesting from PRODML Sample object, then the mapping can be seen below: 
PreviousContainerID = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].PreviousContainer

CurrentContainerID.title: Current Container ID
CurrentContainerID.description:
The OSDU ID of the current container used to hold the sample at the end of the chain of custody event.
Eg. if ingesting from PRODML Sample object, then the mapping can be seen below: 
CurrentContainerID = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].CurrentContainer

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description:
Pertinent information about this object stored alongside other attributes of this object.
Eg. if ingesting from PRODML Sample object, then the mapping can be seen below: 
Remarks = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].Remark

example.Remark: Transfer process resulted in lost volume.

SampleID.description: The OSDU Record ID for the Sample.

RemainingSampleProperties.title: Remaining Sample Properties

CurrentStorageLocation.title: Final Storage Location

Eg. if ingesting from PRODML Sample object, then the mapping can be seen below: 
CurrentContainerID = PRODML:2.1:FluidSample.FluidSampleChainOfCustodyEvent[].CurrentContainer

/data/Generated/master-data/Seismic2DInt.title: Seismic2DInterpretationSet
/data/Generated/master-data/Seismic2DInt.description: A seismic 2D interpretation set is a collection of logical processed lines and associated trace datasets that represent an important and uniform set for interpretation.  It does not comprise all of the datasets with a common processing geometry, nor all of the lines/datasets from a processing project, nor all of the lines/datasets from an acquisition project, because some are not suitable for interpretation.  An interpretation survey may include 2D lines and datasets from more than one acquisition or processing project.  Consequently, it is not an acquisition survey nor a processing survey.  It is not an application project, which is a collection of all the various objects an application and user care about for some analysis (seismic, wells, etc.).  It inherits properties shared by project entities because it can serve to capture the archiving of a master or authorized project activity.  Interpretation objects (horizons) are hung from an interpretation project to give context and to derive spatial location based on the processing geometry of the associated 2D lines. Trace datasets and seismic horizons are associated through LineageAssertion, although a master collection of trace datasets and horizons are explicitly related through a child relationship property.

/data/Generated/master-data/Seismic3DInt.title: Seismic3DInterpretationSet
/data/Generated/master-data/Seismic3DInt.description: A seismic 3D interpretation survey is a collection of trace datasets with a common bin grid that are important for interpretation.  It does not comprise all of the datasets with a common bin grid, nor all of the datasets from a processing project, nor all of the datasets from an acquisition project, because some are not suitable for interpretation.  An interpretation survey may include datasets from more than one acquisition or processing project.  Consequently, it is not an acquisition survey nor a processing survey.  It is not an application project, which is a collection of all the various objects an application and user care about for some analysis (seismic, wells, etc.).  It inherits properties shared by project entities because it can serve to capture the archiving of a master or authorized project activity. Interpretation objects (horizons) are hung from an interpretation survey to give context and to derive spatial location based on the common bin grid.  Trace datasets and seismic horizons are associated through LineageAssertion, although a master collection of trace datasets and horizons are explicitly related through a child relationship property.

/data/Generated/master-data/SeismicProce.title: SeismicProcessingProject
/data/Generated/master-data/SeismicProce.description: A seismic processing project is a type of business project which manages the creation of processed seismic work products. It is not the same as the geometry of the processed traces (binning or bin grid), which is a work product component, although it typically defines a single binning.  A processing project may merge data from multiple field surveys, so it is not required to be equated to a single field survey.  Original processing and re-processing activities generate separate and independent processing projects.

Tubulars can also be equipment which is lowered into the well in the context of drilling, which is then pulled back out.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name of the Tubular Assembly.

ParentWellboreID.title: Parent Wellbore ID
ParentWellboreID.description: Identifier of the Wellbore the Assembly is installed into or run in.

ParentAssemblyID.title: Parent Assembly ID
ParentAssemblyID.description: Optional - Identifier of the parent assembly (in case of side-track, multi-nesting,…) - The Concentric Tubular model is used to identify the Assembly that an Assembly sits inside e.g. Surface Casing set inside Conductor, Tubing set inside Production Casing, a Bumper Spring set inside a Production Tubing Profile Nipple, Liner set inside Casing, etc. This is needed to enable a Digital Well Sketch application to understand relationships between Assemblies and their parent Wellbores.

TubularAssemblyStatus.title: TubularAssemblyStatus
TubularAssemblyStatus.description: Reflects the current status of the Assembly - as 'installed', 'pulled', 'planned',... - Applicable to tubing/completions as opposed to drillstrings. Historical states are recorded in TubularAssemblyStates.

StatusTypeID.title: Status Type ID
StatusTypeID.description: The relationship to the  reference value status type.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: Used to describe the reason of Activity - such as installed, cut/pull, pulling.
Description.example: 7" RIH to 6450m to isolated Zone A.

Date.title: Date
Date.description: Date the status has been established.

TubularAssemblyStates.title: Tubular Assembly States
TubularAssemblyStates.description: The full record of historical and current states of the Assembly. The current active state is recorded in TubularAssemblyStatus.

items.title: TubularAssemblyStatus
items.description: Record that reflects the status of the Assembly - as 'installed', 'pulled', 'planned',... - Applicable to casing, tubing/completions as opposed to drillstrings

StatusTypeID.title: Status Type ID
StatusTypeID.description: The relationship to the  reference value status type.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: Used to describe the reason of Activity - such as installed, cut/pull, pulling.
Description.example: 7" RIH to 6450m to isolated Zone A.

Date.title: Date
Date.description: Date the status has been established.

VerticalMeasurement.title: Vertical Measurement
VerticalMeasurement.description: Either a self-contained vertical reference for the depths in this TubularAssembly or a reference (VerticalReferenceID) to an element in data.VerticalMeasurements[] in the entity defined by VerticalReferenceEntityID e.g. the parent Well.

SuspensionPointMD.title: Suspension Point MD
SuspensionPointMD.description: The Measured Depth that the assembly is suspended from. This  'point' is typically the Measured Depth of the top of the assembly e.g. Hanger though with PBRs the Suspension Point may not be the top.

TubularAssemblyNumber.title: Tubular Assembly Number
TubularAssemblyNumber.description: Sequence of the TubularAssembly (Typically BHA sequence)

StringClassID.title: String Class ID
StringClassID.description: Descriptor for Assembly, e.g. Production, Surface, Conductor, Intermediate, Drilling

ActivityTypeID.title: Activity Type ID
ActivityTypeID.description: Used to describe if it belongs to a RunActivity or to a PullActivity

ActivityTypeReasonDescription.title: Activity Type Reason Description
ActivityTypeReasonDescription.description: Used to describe the reason of Activity - such as cut/pull, pulling,…

ArtificialLiftTypeID.title: Artificial Lift Type ID
ArtificialLiftTypeID.description: Type of Artificial Lift supported by the TubularAssembly where applicable E.g. could be "Surface Pump" / "Submersible Pump" / "Gas Lift", etc

LinerTypeID.title: Liner Type ID
LinerTypeID.description: This reference table describes the type of liner used in the borehole where applicable. For example, slotted, gravel packed or pre-perforated etc.

IsMixedString.title: Is Mixed String
IsMixedString.description: True if the assembly is a mixed string, else false. True where the Tubular Assembly is made up of joints with different Diameters, Weights, Grades, Connection, Tensile Strengths, Collapse Resistance or  Yield Strengths.

IsInstalled.title: Is Installed
IsInstalled.description: Indicates if the Tubular Assembly is currently downhole.

TubularDirectionID.title: Tubular Direction ID
TubularDirectionID.description: Defines whether the sequence of child tubular components runs either top to bottom, or bottom to top.

TubularAssemblyNominalSize.title: Tubular Assembly Nominal Size
TubularAssemblyNominalSize.description: Nominal size (diameter) describing the whole assembly, e.g. 9.625", 12.25

TubularAssemblyTotalLength.title: Tubular Assembly Total Length
TubularAssemblyTotalLength.description: Total Length of the whole assembly.

DriftDiameter.title: DriftDiameter
DriftDiameter.description: The drift diameter is the inside diameter (ID) that the pipe manufacturer guarantees per specifications. The drift diameter is used by the well planner to determine what size tools or casing strings can later be run through the casing, whereas the nominal inside diameter is used for fluid volume calculations such as mud circulating times and cement slurry placement calculations. Note that the nominal inside diameter is not the same as the drift diameter but is always slightly larger.

MinimumInnerDiameter.title: Minimum Inner Diameter
MinimumInnerDiameter.description: This is the minimum inner diameter of the whole Tubular Assembly.

SeaFloorPenetrationLength.title: Sea Floor Penetration Length
SeaFloorPenetrationLength.description: The distance that the Tubular Assembly has penetrated below the surface of the sea floor.

AssemblyTopMD.title: Assembly Top MD
AssemblyTopMD.description: The measured depth at the top of the Tubular Assembly

AssemblyBaseMD.title: Assembly Base MD
AssemblyBaseMD.description: The measured depth at the base (bottom) of the Tubular Assembly

AssemblyTopReportedTVD.title: Assembly Top Reported TVD
AssemblyTopReportedTVD.description: True Vertical Depth of the top of the Assembly

AssemblyBaseReportedTVD.title: Assembly Base Reported TVD
AssemblyBaseReportedTVD.description: True Vertical Depth of the base of the Assembly

items.description: Reflects the current status of the Assembly - as 'installed', 'pulled', 'planned',... - Applicable to tubing/completions as opposed to drillstrings. Historical states are recorded in TubularAssemblyStates.

StatusTypeID.title: Status Type ID
StatusTypeID.description: The relationship to the  reference value status type.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: Used to describe the reason of Activity - such as installed, cut/pull, pulling.
Description.example: 7" RIH to 6450m to isolated Zone A.

Date.title: Date
Date.description: Date the status has been established.

VerticalMeasurement.title: Vertical Measurement
VerticalMeasurement.description: Either a self-contained vertical reference for the depths in this TubularAssembly or a reference (VerticalReferenceID) to an element in data.VerticalMeasurements[] in the entity defined by VerticalReferenceEntityID e.g. the parent Well.

SuspensionPointMD.title: Suspension Point MD
SuspensionPointMD.description: The Measured Depth that the assembly is suspended from. This  'point' is typically the Measured Depth of the top of the assembly e.g. Hanger though with PBRs the Suspension Point may not be the top.

TubularAssemblyNumber.title: Tubular Assembly Number
TubularAssemblyNumber.description: Sequence of the TubularAssembly (Typically BHA sequence or simply BHA #)

StringClassID.title: String Class ID
StringClassID.description: Descriptor for Assembly, e.g. Production, Surface, Conductor, Intermediate, Drilling

ActivityTypeID.title: Activity Type ID
ActivityTypeID.description: Used to describe if it belongs to a RunActivity or to a PullActivity

ActivityTypeReasonDescription.title: Activity Type Reason Description
ActivityTypeReasonDescription.description: Used to describe the reason of Activity - such as cut/pull, pulling,…

ArtificialLiftTypeID.title: Artificial Lift Type ID
ArtificialLiftTypeID.description: Type of Artificial Lift supported by the TubularAssembly where applicable E.g. could be "Surface Pump" / "Submersible Pump" / "Gas Lift", etc

LinerTypeID.title: Liner Type ID
LinerTypeID.description: This reference table describes the type of liner used in the borehole where applicable. For example, slotted, gravel packed or pre-perforated etc.

IsMixedString.title: Is Mixed String
IsMixedString.description: True if the assembly is a mixed string, else false. True where the Tubular Assembly is made up of joints with different Diameters, Weights, Grades, Connection, Tensile Strengths, Collapse Resistance or  Yield Strengths.

IsInstalled.title: Is Installed
IsInstalled.description: Indicates if the Tubular Assembly is currently downhole.

TubularDirectionID.title: Tubular Direction ID
TubularDirectionID.description: Defines whether the sequence of child tubular components runs either top to bottom, or bottom to top.

TubularAssemblyNominalSize.title: Tubular Assembly Nominal Size
TubularAssemblyNominalSize.description: Nominal size (diameter) describing the whole assembly, e.g. 9.625", 12.25

TubularAssemblyTotalLength.title: Tubular Assembly Total Length
TubularAssemblyTotalLength.description: Total Length of the whole assembly.

DriftDiameter.title: DriftDiameter
DriftDiameter.description: The drift diameter is the inside diameter (ID) that the pipe manufacturer guarantees per specifications. The drift diameter is used by the well planner to determine what size tools or casing strings can later be run through the casing, whereas the nominal inside diameter is used for fluid volume calculations such as mud circulating times and cement slurry placement calculations. Note that the nominal inside diameter is not the same as the drift diameter but is always slightly larger.

MinimumInnerDiameter.title: Minimum Inner Diameter
MinimumInnerDiameter.description: This is the minimum inner diameter of the whole Tubular Assembly.

SeaFloorPenetrationLength.title: Sea Floor Penetration Length
SeaFloorPenetrationLength.description: The distance that the Tubular Assembly has penetrated below the surface of the sea floor.

AssemblyTopMD.title: Assembly Top MD
AssemblyTopMD.description: The measured depth at the top of the Tubular Assembly

AssemblyBaseMD.title: Assembly Base MD
AssemblyBaseMD.description: The measured depth at the base (bottom) of the Tubular Assembly

AssemblyTopReportedTVD.title: Assembly Top Reported TVD
AssemblyTopReportedTVD.description: True Vertical Depth of the top of the Assembly

AssemblyBaseReportedTVD.title: Assembly Base Reported TVD
AssemblyBaseReportedTVD.description: True Vertical Depth of the base of the Assembly

FluidLostVolume.title: Fluid Lost Volume
FluidLostVolume.description: Fluid Lost Volume when running assembly in hole

InHoleDate.title: Date In Hole
InHoleDate.description: Date/time Assembly started to be run in hole

LandedDepthAdjustment.title: Landed Depth Adjustment
LandedDepthAdjustment.description: Depth Adjustment for use in Landed Depth calculation. Set MD = Top MD + Assembly Length + Depth Adjustment. Note that Depth Adjustment can be positive or negative length.

TaggedMD.title: Tagged Measured Depth
TaggedMD.description: Tagged Measured Depth comparison to estimated Landed Depth
