/data/Generated/master-data/TubularUmbil.title: TubularUmbilical
/data/Generated/master-data/TubularUmbil.description: An umbilical is any control, power or sensor cable or tube run through an outlet on the wellhead down to a particular receptacle on a downhole component (power or hydraulic line) or simply to a specific depth (sensors). Examples include Gas lift injection tube, Subsea valve control line, ESP power cable, iWire for external gauges, external Fiber Optic Sensor cable. Umbilicals are run outside of the casing or completion assembly and are typically attached by clamps. Umbilicals are run in hole same time as the host assembly. Casing Umbilicals may be cemented in place e.g. Fiber Optic.

DefaultVerticalMeasurementID.description: The default datum reference point, or zero depth point, used to determine other points vertically in a well.  References an entry in the VerticalMeasurements array.

DefaultVerticalCRSID.description: The default vertical coordinate reference system used in the vertical measurements for a well or wellbore if absent from input vertical measurements and there is no other recourse for obtaining a valid CRS.

VerticalMeasurements.description: List of all depths and elevations pertaining to the well, like, water depth, mud line elevation, etc.

VerticalMeasurementID.description: The ID for a distinct vertical measurement within the Wellbore VerticalMeasurements array so that it may be referenced by other vertical measurements if necessary.

rigid.title: Rig ID
rigid.description: The relationship to the rig, which was used while this vertical measurement was in active use.

InterestTypeID.description: Business Interest [Well Interest Type] describes whether a company currently considers a well or its data to be a real or planned asset, and if so, the nature of and motivation for that company's interest.

BusinessIntentionID.title: Business Intention ID
BusinessIntentionID.description: Business Intention [Well Business Intention] is the general purpose for which resources are approved for drilling a new well or subsequent wellbore(s).

RoleID.title: Role ID
RoleID.description: Role [Well Role] is the current purpose, whether planned or actual. If there are multiple Roles among a well's components, the well may be assigned the facet value with the highest significance. The value of Role may change over the Life Cycle.

HistoricalInterests.title: Historical Interests
HistoricalInterests.description: The list of past and present interests associated with the time period they were/are valid

items.title: HistoricalInterest
items.description: A 'well interest' at some time period as defined by effective and termination date.

InterestTypeID.title: Interest Type ID
InterestTypeID.description: Business Interest [Well Interest Type] describes whether a company currently considers a well or its data to be a real or planned asset, and if so, the nature of and motivation for that company's interest.

EffectiveDateTime.title: Effective Date Time
EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which the well interest type becomes effective.

TerminationDateTime.title: Termination Date Time
TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the well interest type is no longer in effect.

WasBusinessInterestFinancialOperated.title: BusinessInterestFinancialOperatedFormerly
WasBusinessInterestFinancialOperated.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this well has ever been FinancialOperated in the past.

WasBusinessInterestFinancialNonOperated.title: BusinessInterestFinancialNonOperatedFormerly
WasBusinessInterestFinancialNonOperated.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this well has ever been FinancialNonOperated in the past.

WasBusinessInterestObligatory.title: BusinessInterestObligatoryFormerly
WasBusinessInterestObligatory.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this well has ever been Obligatory in the past.

WasBusinessInterestTechnical.title: BusinessInterestTechnicalFormerly
WasBusinessInterestTechnical.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this well has ever been Technical in the past.

ConditionID.title: ConditionID
ConditionID.description: Condition [Well Condition] is the operational state of a well component relative to the Role [Well Role].

OutcomeID.title: OutcomeID
OutcomeID.description: Outcome [Well Drilling Outcome] is the result of attempting to accomplish the Business Intention [Well Business Intention].

StatusSummaryID.title: StatusSummaryID
StatusSummaryID.description: Identifies the status of a well component in a way that may combine and-or summarize concepts found in other status facets. For example, a Well Status Summary of Gas Injector Shut-in, which contains commonly desired business information, combines concepts from Product Type, Fluid Direction, and Condition.

WellSiteStructureID.title: Well Site Structure
WellSiteStructureID.description: An optional relationship to a WellSiteStructure, e.g., Pad, Platform, Subsea Template.

SlotID.title: Slot Identifier
SlotID.description: Optional identifier of a slot. It requires that the relationship WellSiteStructureID is populated. SlotID must match a member in the related WellSiteStructure data.WellSlots[].SlotID.

SequenceNumber.description: A number that indicates the order in which wellbores were drilled.

VerticalMeasurements.description: List of all depths and elevations pertaining to the wellbore, like, plug back measured depth, total measured depth, KB elevation

VerticalMeasurementID.description: The ID for a distinct vertical measurement within the Wellbore VerticalMeasurements array so that it may be referenced by other vertical measurements if necessary.

RigID.title: Rig ID
RigID.description: The relationship to the rig, which was used while this vertical measurement was in active use.

DrillingReasons.description: The history of drilling reasons of the wellbore.

WellboreReasonID.description: The relationship to a reference-data record explaining the reason why this wellbore was drilled.

KickOffWellbore.description: This is a pointer to the parent wellbore. The wellbore that starts from top has no parent.

TrajectoryTypeID.description: Profile Type [Wellbore Trajectory Type] is the general geometry of the wellbore relative to the vertical plane. The specific criteria for Profile Type may vary by operator or regulator. The facet value may change if conditions encountered during drilling are not what was planned or permitted.

DefinitiveTrajectoryID.description: SRN of Wellbore Trajectory which is considered the authoritative or preferred version.

TargetFormation.description: The Formation of interest for which the Wellbore is drilled to interact with. The Wellbore may terminate in a lower formation if the requirement is to drill through the entirety of the target formation, therefore this is not necessarily the Formation at TD.

FormationNameAtTotalDepth.description: The name of the formation encountered at total depth. The value is not controlled by any reference value list.

PrimaryMaterialID.description: DEPRECATED: Please use PrimaryProductTypeID instead, which refers to the narrower WellProductType. The primary material injected/produced from the wellbore.

DefaultVerticalMeasurementID.description: The default datum reference point, or zero depth point, used to determine other points vertically in a wellbore.  References an entry in the Vertical Measurements array of this wellbore.

ProjectedBottomHoleLocation.description: The bottom hole location of the wellbore denoted by a projected horizontal coordinate reference system (Horizontal CRS), such a UTM zone. 'Projected' in this property does not mean 'planned' or 'projected-to-bit'. If both GeographicBottomHoleLocation and ProjectedBottomHoleLocation properties are populated on this wellbore, they must identify the same point, just in different CRSs.

GeographicBottomHoleLocation.description: The bottom hole location of the wellbore denoted by a specified geographic horizontal coordinate reference system (Horizontal CRS), such as WGS84, NAD27, or ED50. If both GeographicBottomHoleLocation and ProjectedBottomHoleLocation properties are populated on this wellbore, they must identify the same point, just in different CRSs.

BusinessIntentionID.description: Business Intention [Well Business Intention] is the general purpose for which resources are approved for drilling a new well or subsequent wellbore(s).

RoleID.description: Role [Well Role] is the current purpose, whether planned or actual. If there are multiple Roles among a wellbore's components, the well may be assigned the facet value with the highest significance. The value of Role may change over the Life Cycle.

InterestTypeID.description: Business Interest [Well Interest Type] describes whether a company currently considers a wellbore entity or its data to be a real or planned asset, and if so, the nature of and motivation for that company's interest.

HistoricalInterests.description: The list of past and present interests associated with the time period they were/are valid

items.title: HistoricalInterest
items.description: A 'well interest' at some time period as defined by effective and termination date.

InterestTypeID.title: Interest Type ID
InterestTypeID.description: Business Interest [Well Interest Type] describes whether a company currently considers a wellbore or its data to be a real or planned asset, and if so, the nature of and motivation for that company's interest.

EffectiveDateTime.title: Effective Date Time
EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which the well interest type becomes effective.

TerminationDateTime.title: Termination Date Time
TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the well interest type is no longer in effect.

WasBusinessInterestFinancialOperated.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been FinancialOperated in the past.

WasBusinessInterestFinancialNonOperated.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been FinancialNonOperated in the past.

WasBusinessInterestObligatory.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been Obligatory in the past.

WasBusinessInterestTechnical.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been Technical in the past.

WellboreTrajectoryTypeID.description: DEPRECATED: Added accidentally in version 1.1.0. Please use the original TrajectoryTypeID instead. Profile Type [Wellbore Trajectory Type] is the general geometry of the wellbore relative to the vertical plane. The specific criteria for Profile Type may vary by operator or regulator. The facet value may change if conditions encountered during drilling are not what was planned or permitted.

PrimaryProductTypeID.description: Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Primary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is most significant.

SecondaryProductTypeID.description: Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Secondary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is the second most significant.

TertiaryProductTypeID.description: Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Tertiary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is the third most significant.

ShowProductTypeID.description: Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Show Product Significance identifies a Product Type present in non-commercial quantity.

ConditionID.description: Condition [Well Condition] is the operational state of a wellbore component relative to the Role [Well Role].

FluidDirectionID.description: Fluid Direction [Well Fluid Direction] is the flow direction of the wellhead stream. The facet value can change over the life of the wellbore.

OutcomeID.description: Outcome [Well Drilling Outcome] is the result of attempting to accomplish the Business Intention [Well Business Intention].

StatusSummaryID.description: Identifies the status of a wellbore component in a way that may combine and-or summarize concepts found in other status facets. For example, a Wellbore Status Summary of Gas Injector Shut-in, which contains commonly desired business information, combines concepts from Product Type, Fluid Direction, and Condition.

WellboreCosts.description: The array of WellActivityPhaseType and associated Cost values.

items.title: WellboreCost
items.description: A cost value associated to a WellActivityPhaseType value.

ActivityTypeID.title: Well Activity Phase Type ID
ActivityTypeID.description: The activity phase to which the Cost property is attributed to.

Cost.title: Cost
Cost.description: The cost value associated with the WellActivityPhaseType.

DefinitiveTrajectoryID.description: SRN of Wellbore Trajectory which is considered the authoritative or preferred version.

TargetFormation.description: The Formation of interest for which the Wellbore is drilled to interact with. The Wellbore may terminate in a lower formation if the requirement is to drill through the entirety of the target formation, therefore this is not necessarily the Formation at TD.

FormationNameAtTotalDepth.description: The name of the formation encountered at total depth. The value is not controlled by any reference value list.

PrimaryMaterialID.description: DEPRECATED: Please use PrimaryProductTypeID instead, which refers to the narrower WellProductType. The primary material injected/produced from the wellbore.

DefaultVerticalMeasurementID.description: The default datum reference point, or zero depth point, used to determine other points vertically in a wellbore.  References an entry in the Vertical Measurements array of this wellbore.

ProjectedBottomHoleLocation.description: The bottom hole location of the wellbore denoted by a projected horizontal coordinate reference system (Horizontal CRS), such a UTM zone. 'Projected' in this property does not mean 'planned' or 'projected-to-bit'. If both GeographicBottomHoleLocation and ProjectedBottomHoleLocation properties are populated on this wellbore, they must identify the same point, just in different CRSs.

GeographicBottomHoleLocation.description: The bottom hole location of the wellbore denoted by a specified geographic horizontal coordinate reference system (Horizontal CRS), such as WGS84, NAD27, or ED50. If both GeographicBottomHoleLocation and ProjectedBottomHoleLocation properties are populated on this wellbore, they must identify the same point, just in different CRSs.

BusinessIntentionID.description: Business Intention [Well Business Intention] is the general purpose for which resources are approved for drilling a new well or subsequent wellbore(s).

RoleID.description: Role [Well Role] is the current purpose, whether planned or actual. If there are multiple Roles among a wellbore's components, the well may be assigned the facet value with the highest significance. The value of Role may change over the Life Cycle.

InterestTypeID.description: Business Interest [Well Interest Type] describes whether a company currently considers a wellbore entity or its data to be a real or planned asset, and if so, the nature of and motivation for that company's interest.

HistoricalInterests.description: The list of past and present interests associated with the time period they were/are valid

items.title: HistoricalInterest
items.description: A 'well interest' at some time period as defined by effective and termination date.

InterestTypeID.title: Interest Type ID
InterestTypeID.description: Business Interest [Well Interest Type] describes whether a company currently considers a wellbore or its data to be a real or planned asset, and if so, the nature of and motivation for that company's interest.

EffectiveDateTime.title: Effective Date Time
EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which the well interest type becomes effective.

TerminationDateTime.title: Termination Date Time
TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the well interest type is no longer in effect.

WasBusinessInterestFinancialOperated.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been FinancialOperated in the past.

WasBusinessInterestFinancialNonOperated.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been FinancialNonOperated in the past.

WasBusinessInterestObligatory.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been Obligatory in the past.

WasBusinessInterestTechnical.description: Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been Technical in the past.

WellboreTrajectoryTypeID.description: DEPRECATED: Added accidentally in version 1.1.0. Please use the original TrajectoryTypeID instead. Profile Type [Wellbore Trajectory Type] is the general geometry of the wellbore relative to the vertical plane. The specific criteria for Profile Type may vary by operator or regulator. The facet value may change if conditions encountered during drilling are not what was planned or permitted.

PrimaryProductTypeID.description: Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Primary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is most significant.

SecondaryProductTypeID.description: Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Secondary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is the second most significant.

TertiaryProductTypeID.description: Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Tertiary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is the third most significant.

ShowProductTypeID.description: Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Show Product Significance identifies a Product Type present in non-commercial quantity.

ConditionID.description: Condition [Well Condition] is the operational state of a wellbore component relative to the Role [Well Role].

FluidDirectionID.description: Fluid Direction [Well Fluid Direction] is the flow direction of the wellhead stream. The facet value can change over the life of the wellbore.

OutcomeID.description: Outcome [Well Drilling Outcome] is the result of attempting to accomplish the Business Intention [Well Business Intention].

StatusSummaryID.description: Identifies the status of a wellbore component in a way that may combine and-or summarize concepts found in other status facets. For example, a Wellbore Status Summary of Gas Injector Shut-in, which contains commonly desired business information, combines concepts from Product Type, Fluid Direction, and Condition.

WellboreCosts.description: The array of WellActivityPhaseType and associated Cost values.

items.title: WellboreCost
items.description: A cost value associated to a WellActivityPhaseType value.

ActivityTypeID.title: Well Activity Type ID
ActivityTypeID.description: The activity type, to which the Cost property is attributed to. The intended target reference-data type is WellActivityType; Wellbore:1.3.0 and Wellbore:1.4.0 used WellActivityPhaseType incorrectly.

Cost.title: Cost
Cost.description: The cost value associated with the WellActivityPhaseType.

IsActive.description: A Y/N flag indicating whether this license is currently either active / valid (Y) or inactive / invalid (N).

ApprovedContractorID.description: The validated contractor for this license, as approved.  The term contractor has variable interpretations globally, in this instance the contractor is generally meant to be the contractor who will conduct initial operations on the well for drilling to final TD.

ApprovedDrillSlot.description: Number for the approved drill slot on the offshore platform. Platforms have 24 to 32 slots in which to position derricks for drilling. Each slot may require a different license in some jurisdictions, while others approve all operations on a platform at the same time. If this property is absent, the license applies to all slots.

ApprovedPurposeDescription.description: The approved purpose for the well proposal in narrative form.  This often contains formation or depth information along with aggregated information from the Well Status and Classifications facets Business Intention, Play Type, Role, Product Type and Fluid Direction. The Well License Status subset allows this information to be decomposed into facets for better clarity.

ApprovedRigID.description: Sometimes specific rigs may be authorized by a license, particularly where environmental or access restrictions set specific requirements.  This attribute identifies the specific rig approved, where needed.

ApprovedRigSubstructureHeight.description: The height of the foundation on which the derrick and engine sits.

ApprovedRigTypeID.description: The type of rig installation the license is approved for, where this is relevant. For example land, barge, submersible, platform, jackup, drillship, semisub, artificial island...

ApprovedSpudDate.description: The approved spud date, can be the same as shown on the license application or may be changed as a result of the discussions involved in the approval process or changes to the circumstances surrounding the well plan.

ApprovedSurveyorID.description: Surveying is a specialized skill that requires certification before it can be practiced in most regions.  The name of the surveyor or surveying company provides evidence that a properly qualified individual will conduct the survey.

ApprovedTargetObjectiveProductIDs.description: The WellProductType(s) (e.g., fluid) that is/are approved for the well license.  In some regions, WellProductTypes are approved individually or as a group.  Similarly, in some regions, specific WellProductTypes may be excluded from the well license, particularly if the land right obtained does not include those WellProductTypes.

ApprovedWellIDs.description: A well license may be assigned to an entire planned well configuration at the time the license is granted. Other licenses may be assigned to specific well components.  Where the component is known, specific relationships are needed.

ApprovedWellCount.description: The number of wells that are approved under this license.  Not all regulators define wells the same way.  Some regulators may identify the number of wellbores, others the number of well origins. Refer to PPDM "What is a Well" for more information about well components.

ApprovedWellboreIDs.description: A well license may be assigned to one or more wellbores at the time the license is granted. Other licenses may be assigned to specific well components as defined in What is a Well.  Where the component is known, specific relationships are needed.

AuthorizedStratigraphicUnit.description: The formation authorized for use. May not be the same as the projected formation at the final depth of a wellbore.

AuthorizedStratigraphicUnitUseRoleID.description: For the formation specified in the license, the use that this formation may be used for, such as production, injection, disposal, storage etc.

BiddingRoundIdentifier.description: Bidding round number for drilling rights that resulted in this license.

IsDelayed.description: When a license is delayed, set this flag to True.  Details about the application can be found in the application object.

ExpiredDate.description: The date on which a license has expired.  Note that this may be different than the due date, particularly where extensions are granted or specific conditions as stated in the license are met or not met.

IsExpired.description: When the license expires, set the expiry date to the appropriate date, and set this flag to True.

ExpiryDueDate.description: The date when the license has or is due to expire.  In many cases, the date when the license term will expire is stated in the license.  This date may therefore be a date in the future. There may be conditions under which the license can be extended.  Where this occurs, the extension should usually be captured as a new version of the license.

GrantedByBusinessAssociateID.description: Identify the business associate, most often a regulator or authorized agency, has granted the license.  In some cases, other authorities may grant licenses, attribute is not intended to be proscriptive.

LicenseDate.description: Date the well license was issued.  This date may not be the same as the date entered into the system.

LicenseIssuedDate.description: The date on which the license has been issued and comes into effect.  Normally, no operations that involve surface or subsurface disturbance may be started before this date.

LicensePrimaryTerm.description: The primary term of the license as set by the agency granting the license.

LicenseReissueDate.description: The date the permit or license was reissued. The regulatory approval normally expires after the primary term unless an extension is requested and granted.

LicenseReissueTerm.description: The secondary term of the license, often 6 - 12 months in duration.  These are granted by the regulatory authority after requests for renewal are submitted by the operator or the address for service.

LicenseType.description: The type of license granted is often based on codes and rules set out in legislation or regulation.  This license type attribute should indicate the exact type as specified in the license document.

LicenseeID.description: The licensee to whom this license has been granted.  Sometimes, the licensees may be an address for service, particularly for confidential operations. This is not necessarily the name of the operator or the owner of the well.

LicenseeContactBusinessAssociateID.description: The business associate who is the contact representing the licensee for this license.

ProjectedMeasuredDepth.description: Projected measured depth at which the drilling of the primary wellbore is planned to be terminated. When multiple wellbores are planned, this may be the depth of the deepest wellbore, depending on local rules.

ProjectedStratigraphicUnitID.description: The stratigraphic unit that is proposed for final completion and production (or injection). Note that this may not be the formation at the planned final depth of the wellbore. The stratigraphic unit should be part of the ProjectedStratigraphicColumn.

ProjectedTrueVerticalDepth.description: Projected true vertical depth of the well determined during the permitting of the well.

VerticalMeasurement.description: The measured elevation from a known reference datum to a permanent geodetic datum.  This measurement is the foundation for calculating and correlating depths from geodetic datums, which in turn allow depth correlation between wellbores.

RegulationSection.description: The section of  the regulation under which the license was granted. For Example, the type of permit (such as Rule 37 or Rule 38 in the State of Texas) that is given for the well.

RigTypeID.description:
A reference table describing the overall structure of the rig with respect to the environment and function. For example land, barge, submersible, platform, jackup, drillship, semisub or artificial island.

Sometimes specific types of rigs may be authorized by a license, particularly where environmental or access restrictions set specific requirements.

StratigraphicColumnID.description: The name of the set of formation names used for interpretations.  Different name sets may exist on a regional or basin basis, or may be developed by regulatory agencies, data vendors or operating companies.  Clarity about which name set is used is critical to ensuring that the name of the formation is not ambiguous.

OperatingEnvironmentID.description: The reference to the operating environment of the well/wellbore this license applies to.

LicenseConditions.description: Details about conditions imposed on a license by an authority, a partner or other stakeholder.

LicenseRemarks.description: Remarks and narratives associated to the license.

LicenseStates.description: Details about LicenseStates, past and present.

LicenseViolations.description: Details about violations of conditions, past and present.

WellboreID.title: Wellbore ID
WellboreID.description: The Wellbore where the well log acquisition was recorded.

VerticalMeasurement.title: Vertical Measurement
VerticalMeasurement.description: The vertical measurement reference for this well logging acquisition activity. This object defines the vertical reference datum for the measured depths.

LogRuns.title: Log Runs
LogRuns.description: The tools run in the hole for the purpose of acquiring well log measurements. Defined as a single tool string run below the reference datum e.g. KB, RT. A log run may consist of one or many Log Passes.

items.title: LogRuns
items.description: A log run identifies a single series of combinable logging tools that are entered into the wellbore below the reference depth (e.g. KB, the).

LogRunID.description: A unique identifier for a specific log run. This can be a number or alphanumeric.

GenericToolTypeIDs.title: Generic Tool Type IDs
GenericToolTypeIDs.description: An array of well log generic tool types used in this Log Run.

ToolMnemonicIDs.title: Tool Mnemonics IDs
ToolMnemonicIDs.description: An array of PWLS tool mnemonics used in this Log Run.

SamplingStart.title: Sampling Start
SamplingStart.description: The smallest value/first value of the log index for this log run.

SamplingStop.title: Sampling Stop
SamplingStop.description: The largest value/last value of the log index for this log run.

WellboreFluidTypeID.title: Wellbore Fluid Type ID
WellboreFluidTypeID.description:
The type of fluid in the wellbore at time of logging 
e.g. oil based mud, water based mud, water. This property could be overridden by the LogPass wellbore fluid type.

ConveyanceMethodID.title: Conveyance Method ID
ConveyanceMethodID.description: The conveyance method used to acquire the log data e.g. wireline, LWD, pipe conveyed.

SensorOffsetDocumentID.title: Sensor Offset Document ID
SensorOffsetDocumentID.description: A relationship to the document record within the OSDU Platform containing the tool sensor offsets, for example a tool string diagram or report.

ContractorCompanyID.title: ContractorCompanyID
ContractorCompanyID.description:
The relationship to a service or contractor organisation, typically the producer or logging contractor for this particular and identifiable Log Run. Typically this is the same as the overall well log acquisition.
Only populate this property if a particular and identifiable Log Run has a different or specifically identifiable service or contracting company to the Well Log Acquisition project as a whole. 
The overall contracting company is captured under the `Project.Contractors[]` array. This `Project.Contractors[]` array can capture all Contractors associated with the overall Well Log Acquisition project activity, but can not be associated to a specific Log Run.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: Remarks specific to this log run.

LogPasses.title: LogPasses
LogPasses.description: The logging passes within this single logging run.

items.title: LogPasses
items.description: A log pass identifies a single acquisition event or job.  A log run my contain one or multiple log passes.

PassTypeID.title: Pass Type ID
PassTypeID.description: The type of log pass such as Calibration Pass, Main Pass, Repeated Pass.

LoggingDirectionID.title: Logging Direction ID
LoggingDirectionID.description:
The direction of logging for this log pass.
Specifies whether the logging information was collected in an downward or upward direction or stationary.

IndexTypeID.title: Index Type ID
IndexTypeID.description:
The index reference type for this log pass e.g. depth, time, counter, calendar time.
IndexTypeID corresponds to WellLog data.SamplingDomainTypeID.

SamplingInterval.title: Sampling Interval
SamplingInterval.description:
For regularly sampled curves this property holds the sampling interval for this Log Pass. 
For a non regular sampling interval this property is not set. The IsRegularSamplingInterval flag indicates whether the SamplingInterval is required.

IsRegularSamplingInterval.title: Is Regular Sample Interval Flag
IsRegularSamplingInterval.description:
A boolean property indicating the sampling mode of the index or reference curve for this Log Pass. 

True means all reference curve values are regularly spaced (see SamplingInterval). False means irregular or discrete sample spacing.

FlowingConditionID.title: Flowing Condition ID
FlowingConditionID.description: The flowing condition of the wellbore during the log acquisition e.g. Static or Dynamic

SamplingStart.title: Sampling Start
SamplingStart.description: The smallest value/first value of the log index for this log pass.

SamplingStop.title: Sampling Stop
SamplingStop.description: The largest value/last value of the log index for this log pass.

WellboreFluidTypeID.title: Wellbore Fluid Type ID
WellboreFluidTypeID.description:
The type of fluid in the wellbore at time of acquisition of the log pass e.g. oil based mud, water based mud, water.
Only populate if it is different to the wellbore fluid identified in the log run.

HoleTypeIDs.title: Hole Type IDs
HoleTypeIDs.description: The type of hole logged in this pass e.g. open hole, cased hole, cemented hole.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: Remarks specific to this log pass.

SampleAcquisitionJobIDs.title: Sample Acquisition Job IDs
SampleAcquisitionJobIDs.description: A reference to the Sample Acquisition Job for samples acquired in the same logging pass. This can be one or more Sample Acquisition Jobs.

/data/Generated/master-data/WellPressure.title: WellPressureTestAcquisitionJob
/data/Generated/master-data/WellPressure.description:
A Well Pressure Test Acquisition Job is a subset of a Well Pressure Test Acquisition Program - usually assigned to a single contracting company and summarizing the overall testing phases (multiple measurement stations, run over multiple passes from one or more runs).
The Acquisition String can change between two different runs - and at each station, only a subset of the "in place" string can be activated - which subset can evolve from 1 measurement to the other.

AliasNameUniqueValueIndicator.description: Indicates whether the value for alias names of a given alias name type must be universally unique. 'Y' indicates that there is a requirement for unique values. 'N' indicates that there is no requirement for unique values.

AliasNameTypeClassID.description: This supports the type of AliasName (such as Standard Identifier, System Identifier, and so on). AliasNameTypeClass is intended to be used to categorize alias name types by their general purpose, with values like "Standard Identifier", "System Identifier", and "Moniker". Combined with the AliasNameType, and DefinitionOrganisation one can define a complete context for a particular identifier or name. For example, a standard identifier of type Regulatory ID, from API, is the US standards regulatory ID; a standard identifier of type company ID, from BigOil, is BigOil's Standard ID; System Identifiers would be particular to systems of record, or other systems, and Monikers, things like display names, plot labels, etc.

/data/Generated/reference-data/ChronoStr.title: ChronoStratigraphy
/data/Generated/reference-data/ChronoStr.description: The reference value type for Chronostratigraphic classification. The purpose of chronostratigraphic classification is to organize systematically the rocks forming the Earth's crust into named units (chronostratigraphic units) that represent intervals of geologic time (geochronologic units) to serve as references in narratives about Earth history including the evolution of life. Records of this kind represent chronostratigraphic units, i.e., bodies of rocks that include all rocks representative of a specific interval of geologic time, and only this time span. Chronostratigraphic units are bounded by isochronous horizons which mark specific moments of geological time. The rank (via data.ChronostratigraphicHierarchy) and relative magnitude of the units in the chronostratigraphic hierarchy are a function of the durations they represent.

MapStateID.title: Map State ID
MapStateID.description: The mapping status declaring whether the mapping is straight forward, direct (identical) or whether special treatment is required (corrected). Items, which are known not to be mappable are declared as unsupported.

HasGlobalScope.title: Has Global Scope
HasGlobalScope.description: A flag — if true — indicating that this mapping has global scope and does not apply to specific external entity types only. If false, the Scope is required. Scope should be made part of the Code and id

Scope.title: Scope
Scope.description: The scope of the mapping — Global if HasGlobalScope is true, or the external entity type name, to which this mapping is exclusively assigned.

SimpleMap.title: Simple Map
SimpleMap.description: The external reference value is mapped to a single OSDU reference value in the target OSDU platform instance.

TargetKind.title: Target Kind
TargetKind.description: Optional, needed if the Scope is not Global: TargetKind defines the record kind in which the PropertyValue is assigned to the PropertyName. The kind does not require the specification of the full semantic version number. If specified, it denotes the first and implicitly higher versions, which are required, typically the version the PropertyValue was added.

PropertyName.title: Property Name
PropertyName.description: Optional, needed if the Scope is not Global: PropertyName defines the cumulative path (dot-separated for nested structures, [] denoting arrays), to which the PropertyValue is to be assigned in the target record of kind TargetKind.

ReferenceValueID.title: Reference Value ID
ReferenceValueID.description: Mandatory: the mapped value (reference-data relationship) in the OSDU target platform instance.

ComplexMappings.title: Complex Mappings
ComplexMappings.description: One external reference value translates into setting multiple reference values (higher normalization in target OSDU platform instance).

/data/Generated/reference-data/ExternalU.title: ExternalUnitOfMeasure
/data/Generated/reference-data/ExternalU.description: A unit of measure description belonging to an external system, which is intended to be mapped or related to a platform-standard UnitOfMeasure record. Mappings can be exact or not. This is expressed by he MapStatus. MapStatus:identical means that the external unit reference can be swapped out by the platform standard reference. MapStatus:corrected indicates same concept but differences in the conversion parameters. Data must be treated or re-labeled; the decision can only be taken on a case by case basis. Finally  MapStatus:unsupported means that there is no equivalent platform standard reference. An ExternalUnitOfMeasure record can be seen as an 'alias' for the UnitOfMeasureID it refers to. Adding NameAliases to UnitOfMeasure is, however, not recommended because local overrides may be lost when new OSDU updates are shipped.

ExternalUnitQuantityID.title: External Unit Quantity ID
ExternalUnitQuantityID.description: The External Unit Quantity is a semantic description of the quantity this ExternalUnitOfMeasure is describing ('Length' for instance).

UnitQuantityID.title: Unit Quantity ID
UnitQuantityID.description: De-normalized, mapped platform standard UnitQuantity, is the ExternalUnitQuantity was indeed mappable.

UnitDimensionCode.title: Unit Dimension Code
UnitDimensionCode.description: The dimensionality using the symbols for dimension as defined in https://www.bipm.org/utils/common/documents/jcgm/JCGM_200_2012.pdf, i.e. L for length, M for mass, T for time, I for electric current, N for amount of substance, J for luminous intensity; except Θ for thermodynamic temperature, which is replaced by the symbol K, the additional symbol D for temperature difference and the additional symbol 0 for no dimension.

IsBaseUnit.title: Base Unit Flag
IsBaseUnit.description: True if the unit is a base unit for the unit quantity. If the property is absent, it means the unit is not a base unit.

UnitDimensionName.title: Unit Dimension Name
UnitDimensionName.description: The name of the unit dimension concept.

PersistableReference.title: Persistable Reference
PersistableReference.description: The self-contained, stringified JSON reference for the unit. This value can be attached to data values and data records and carry the unit reference independent of a UnitOfMeasure instance.

Count.title: Count
Count.description: The number of intervals in this GrainSizeClassificationScheme.

GrainSizeClassificationIDs.title: Grain Size Classification IDs
GrainSizeClassificationIDs.description: The array of GrainSizeClassification associated to the GrainSizes array values. The list is ordered by the coarsest category first followed by finer categories. The array has the length Count;  GrainSizes and SieveNumbers have one element less, Count-1.

GrainSizes.title: Minimum Grain Sizes
GrainSizes.description: The array of minimum grain size diameters, which implicitly defines a continuous ste of intervals. The array has the length Count-1. GrainSizes is ordered by descending values. The first interval is open ended, i.e., larger than GrainSizes[0], the last interval is open ended, i.e., smaller than GranSizes[Count-2].

SieveNumbers.title: ASTM Sieve Numbers
SieveNumbers.description: A string array holding the ASTM E11 sieve numbers (or range size codes). SieveNumbers strings are ordered the same way as the GrainSizeCategories and GrainSizes arrays had has the array length Count-1.

Policy.title: Extraction Policy
Policy.description: Current supported policies are 'ExtractAllMatches' resulting in an array of values or 'ExtractFirstMatch' single value. The policy applies only to the Paths[].ValueExtraction.

Paths.title: Paths
Paths.description: The list of path definitions to derive the property value from.

items.title: Path
items.description: A single path definition to derive a property value from.

RelatedObjectsSpec.title: Related Objects Specification
RelatedObjectsSpec.description: The specification to extract related objects, from which to derive the ValueExtraction. If this property is empty or absent, the ValueExtraction is done on the current object to be indexed.

RelatedObjectID.title: Related Object ID
RelatedObjectID.description: The path to the property containing the ID of the target record to chase. This property is only populated if the property is extracted from a related object, which must be chased. If the property is derived from 'within' the same record, which triggered the indexing, the RelatedObjectID is left absent.

RelatedObjectKind.title: Related Object Kind
RelatedObjectKind.description: The kind or schema id expected as the target object type. This property is only populated if the property is extracted from a related object, which must be chased. If the property is derived from 'within' the same record, which triggered the indexing, the RelatedObjectKind is left absent.

RelationshipDirection.title: Relationship Direction
RelationshipDirection.description: The direction of the relationship definition seen from the object being indexed.  'ChildToParent' assumes an outgoing relationship with the target record defined in the object being indexed. 'ParentToChildren' assumes that the related objects have a relationship by RelatedObjectID to the id of the record being indexed.

RelatedConditionProperty.title: Related Condition Property
RelatedConditionProperty.description: The property path of the target record data block, which needs subjected to the conditional matching. The data prefix is not required.

RelatedConditionMatches.title: Related Condition Matches
RelatedConditionMatches.description: The RelatedConditionProperty values, which need to match in order to be accepted as de-normalized value(s). If the Policy is ExtractFirstMatch, the list is prioritized and the first match is accepted as final value. Policy ExtractAllMatches collects all matching values as array.

ValueExtraction.title: Value Extraction
ValueExtraction.description: The instructions from where to derive the value.

RelatedConditionProperty.title: Related Condition Property
RelatedConditionProperty.description: The property path of the target record data block, which needs to be subjected to the conditional matching. The data prefix is not required in the path.

items.title: Condition

/data/Generated/reference-data/SampleTyp.title: SampleType
/data/Generated/reference-data/SampleTyp.description: The classification of the type of specimen/sample, which is identified for the purpose of analysing the specimen or a subsample of it. For rock, the sample type is based on a combination of general substance type, size, shape, and in certain cases, the retrieval method. For fluids, sample type is based on general substance type and source, which affects how it will be analysed. For other materials, sample type is based primarily on general substance type. In rare cases, the special purpose of a specimen might contribute to its sample type classification.

/data/Generated/reference-data/Subjectiv.title: SubjectiveClassificationRating
/data/Generated/reference-data/Subjectiv.description:
SubjectiveClassificationRating is used for the categorization of ratings, degrees or interpretations that are subjective and dependent on context, often employed to convey relative qualities or degrees. The meanings of these classifications can fluctuate depending on the context they are used in and may be founded on personal beliefs, individual viewpoints, or experiences, rather than on objective, quantifiable criteria.
These classifications are utilized to categorize ratings based on their intended purpose, which could be quantity/size, quality/desirability, strength/intensity, or confidence/certainty.
It’s important to note that these classifications are not designed for use when describing data or interpretations through statistical or data distribution analysis. Furthermore, they are intended to be distinct from data assurance, which strives for a more objective and confident position, typically adhering to standard operating procedures or control and assurance frameworks.

UnitDimensionName.description: The name of the unit dimension concept.

PersistableReference.title: Persistable Reference
PersistableReference.description: The self-contained, stringified JSON reference for the unit. This value can be attached to data values and data records and carry the unit reference independent of a UnitOfRecord instance.

ParentConfigurationID.title: Parent Configuration ID
ParentConfigurationID.description: Optional reference to a UnitOfMeasureConfiguration, from which the majority of definitions are derived.

Configurations.title: Configurations
Configurations.description: The list of configurations associating measurements or properties with preferred and default units.

items.title: Configuration
items.description: A configuration for a UnitQuantity offering a sub-set of units and a default unit.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name of the measurement.

UnitQuantityID.title: Unit Quantity ID
UnitQuantityID.description: The relationship to the UnitQuantity for this configuration. At least one of the fields UnitQuantityID, PropertyType and or PropertyNames must be populated. Scope narrows from UnitQuantityID, PropertyType to PropertyNames.

PropertyType.title: Property Type
PropertyType.description: If specified,Energistics PWLS 3 PropertyType implies a UnitQuantityID and offers a much finer scoping. PropertyType refers to a pair PropertyTypeID (typically a UUID) and a PropertyName. At least one of the fields UnitQuantityID, PropertyType and or PropertyNames must be populated. Scope narrows from UnitQuantityID, PropertyType to PropertyNames.

PropertyNames.title: Property Names
PropertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this configuration should apply. At least one of the fields UnitQuantityID, PropertyType and or PropertyNames must be populated. Scope narrows from UnitQuantityID, PropertyType to PropertyNames.

DefaultUnitID.title: Default Unit ID
DefaultUnitID.description: The default UnitOfMeasure to be used for this measurement name. If empty, the first element of the mandatory PreferredUnitIDs array should be taken. The DefaultUnitID should be member of the PreferredUnitIDs array.

PreferredUnitIDs.title: Preferred Unit IDs
PreferredUnitIDs.description: The preferred sub-set of units, which are meaningful for the domain, app or user. This property is mandatory and must contain at least one element.

NumericFormatType.title: Numeric Format Type
NumericFormatType.description: A hint how the number is expected to be presented, e.g., d or D for decimal, f or F for fixed point, e or E for exponential (scientific), or g or G for general (default). Not all languages support all codes in all cases - in principle the case means that the resulting case is transformed to upper case or lower case depending on the case of the NumericFormatType.

NumericPrecision.title: Numeric Precision
NumericPrecision.description: The number of decimal digits for NumericFormatType f or F or e or E, or the number of significant digits in g or G. If populated in conjunction with NumericFormatType d or D, NumericPrecision defines the minimum number of digits. If the number has less digits than given by NumericPrecision, it is padded with leading zeroes.

/data/Generated/reference-data/UnitQuant.title: UnitQuantity
/data/Generated/reference-data/UnitQuant.description: A single unit quantity class representing a superclass of mutually comparable quantity kinds. The class may or may not represent a recognized quantity kind (i.e., it may logically be abstract).  Quantities of the same class will have the same quantity dimension.  However, quantities of the same dimension are not necessarily of the same class. The term "unit quantity class" is intended to have the same general  meaning as the term "kind of quantity" as defined by the  "International vocabulary of meteorology - Basic and general concepts and associated terms (VIM)" (JCGM 200:2008) https://www.bipm.org/utils/common/documents/jcgm/JCGM_200_2012.pdf.

UnitDimension.title: UnitDimension
UnitDimension.description: The UnitQuantity dimensionality using the symbols for dimension as defined in https://www.bipm.org/utils/common/documents/jcgm/JCGM_200_2012.pdf, i.e. L for length, M for mass, T for time, I for electric current, N for amount of substance, J for luminous intensity; except Θ for thermodynamic temperature, which is replaced by the symbol K, the additional symbol D for temperature difference and the additional symbol 0 for no dimension.

BaseForConversion.title: Base Unit
BaseForConversion.description: The base unit for unit conversion. The symbol of the unit which is used for conversion for of all members of this class. The corresponding baseForConversion must be a member of this class. To convert from one member to another member, you logically convert from the source member to the base and then convert from the base to the target member.

MemberUnits.title: Member Units
MemberUnits.description: Specifies the symbol of a unit of which is a member of this class. Membership indicates that a value of that class can be converted to any other member unit of that class without loss of semantics. This because the conversion formula represents a unitless factor of one.

ParentUnitQuantity.title: Parent Unit Quantity
ParentUnitQuantity.description: Optional parent unit quantity code in case a specialized unit quantity is needed. This is typically used to assign display units to particular measurements like cylinder diameter (small) versus geographic distance (large). I this case the persistable reference string will contain the full ancestry, e.g. "L.length.CylinderDiameter".

PersistableReference.title: Persistable Reference
PersistableReference.description: The self-contained, stringified JSON reference for the unit. This value can be attached to data values and data records and carry the unit quantity reference independent of a UnitQuantity instance.

PrimaryProductTypeID.description: The Primary Product Type permitted in this summary category. Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any well component. A Primary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is most significant.

SecondaryProductTypeID.description: The Secondary Product Type permitted in this summary category. Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any well component. A Secondary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is the second most significant.

TertiaryProductTypeID.description: The Tertiary Product Type permitted in this summary category. Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any well component. A Tertiary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is the third most significant.

ShowProductTypeID.description: The Show Product Type permitted in this summary category. Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any well component. A Show Product Significance identifies a Product Type present in non-commercial quantity.

FluidDirectionID.description: The Fluid Direction permitted in this summary category. Fluid Direction [Well Fluid Direction] is the flow direction of the wellhead stream. The facet value can change over the life of the well.

RoleID.description: The Well Role permitted in this summary category. Role [Well Role] is the current purpose, whether planned or actual. If there are multiple Roles among a well's components, the well may be assigned the facet value with the highest significance. The value of Role may change over the Life Cycle.

ConditionID.description: The Well Condition permitted in this summary category. Condition [Well Condition] is the operational state of a well component relative to the Role [Well Role].

LifecyclePhaseID.description: The Lifecycle Phase [Facility State Type] permitted in this summary category.

BusinessIntentionID.description: The Business Intention permitted in this summary category. Business Intention [Well Business Intention] is the general purpose for which resources are approved for drilling a new well or subsequent wellbore(s).

PlayTypeID.description: Play Type is the focus or area conducive to hydrocarbon discovery and includes the related activities for the development and production of the reservoir.

Description.title: Concept Description
Description.description: A detailed description of the concept represented by the type and, if necessary, with relationships to other concepts/types defined in the ecosystem.

NaturalKeys.title: Natural Keys
NaturalKeys.description: Identifies the natural keys if declared. The keys are identified via the dot notation; example: assume the ProjectName is the natural key for a SeismicAcquisitionSurvey then the natural key reference would be "[data.ProjectName]".

SchemaID.title: Schema ID
SchemaID.description: The schema ID corresponding to the type

Name.title: Type Name
Name.description: The name of the type, or entity type name. The name represents a concept. It is expected that the concept, e.g. Wellbore, can be described by multiple different schemas, which are closely associated with the original data source. Eventually one normalized schema kind is identified, into which the individual contributions can be merged. It is expected that this schema is or is close to the OSDU data definition where defined.

SchemaKind.title: Schema Kind

IsReferenceValueType.title: Reference Value Type Flag

GovernanceModel.title: Governance for Reference Values
GovernanceModel.description: The style of governance (only relevant for IsReferenceValueType==true) - it can be FIXED (content must not be augmented), OPEN (additions and changes allowed) or LOCAL (content is exclusively governed by operator).

items.description: The SRN which identifies this OSDU Work Product Component resource.

IsExtendedLoad.description: A flag that indicates if the work product is undergoing an extended load.  It reflects the fact that the work product is in an early stage and may be updated before finalization.

IsDiscoverable.description: A flag that indicates if the work product is searchable, which means covered in the search index.

Name.description: Name of the instance of Work Product - could be a shipment number.

Description.description: Description of the purpose of the work product.

CreationDateTime.description: Date that a resource (work  product here) is formed outside of OSDU before loading (e.g. publication date, work product delivery package assembly date).

Tags.description: Array of key words to identify the work product, especially to help in search.

SpatialPoint.description: A centroid point that reflects the locale of the content of the work product (location of the subject matter).

SpatialArea.description: A polygon boundary that reflects the locale of the content of the work product (location of the subject matter).

SubmitterName.description: Name of the person that first submitted the work product package to OSDU.

BusinessActivities.description: Array of business processes/workflows that the work product has been through (ex. well planning, exploration).

items.description: Business Activity

AuthorIDs.description: Array of Authors' names of the work product.  Could be a person or company entity.

LineageAssertions.description: Defines relationships with other objects (any kind of Resource) upon which this work product depends.  The assertion is directed only from the asserting WP to ancestor objects, not children.  It should not be used to refer to files or artefacts within the WP -- the association within the WP is sufficient and Artefacts are actually children of the main WP file. /data/Generated/work-product-component/D.title: DataQuality
/data/Generated/work-product-component/D.description: This is used to store result from a run of Data Quality Metric Evaluation engine. Captures summary information, such as which Business rule-set(s) and rule(s) have been used, when this was run and by whom. Detailed result (such as which rule failed, for which meta data item and what was offending value causing the rule to fail) is meant to be made available in a file that is linked to this work-product component. Through Lineage Assertion, this can relate to the entities which were used for the run of Evaluation engine, such as a collection of wells whose meta data were inspected by using a set of rules.

WellboreID.title: Wellbore ID
WellboreID.description: Identifies the wellbore to which the core and the relevant log belong, which were used for the depth-shift.

VerticalReferenceRecordID.title: Vertical Reference Record ID
VerticalReferenceRecordID.description: Identifies the data record that was referenced as the basis for creating this depth shift. Often this identifies a WellLog record with a wireline gamma ray curve.

VerticalReferenceRecordCurveIDs.title: Vertical Reference Record Curve IDs
VerticalReferenceRecordCurveIDs.description: If VerticalReferenceRecordID identifies a well log, this identifies one or more CurveIDs within that WellLog record that define the log curve(s) used to create this depth shift. Usually this identifies a wireline gamma ray curve.

DepthShiftTypeID.title: Depth Shift Type ID
DepthShiftTypeID.description: Identifies the type of depth shift (e.g., core-to-log, log-to-log, seismic time-to-depth, logging-elapsed time-to-depth).

ShiftedSamplingDomainTypeID.title: Shifted Sampling Domain Type ID
ShiftedSamplingDomainTypeID.description: Identifies the original sampling domain (e.g,, time, depth) of target sample/specimen being shifted. This is only to be used when depth-shifting samples, not well logs.

DepthShiftedSamples.title: Depth Shifted Samples
DepthShiftedSamples.description: Identifies the samples/specimens to shift as well as the intended usage of the depth shift with the identified samples. This is only to be used when depth-shifting samples, not well logs.

items.title: Depth Shifted Sample
items.description: Defines the relationship between this depth shift to a sample/specimen (e.g., rock or fluid) as well as the intended usage of the depth shift with the identified sample.

SampleID.title: Sample ID
SampleID.description: Identifies the sample/specimen (e.g., core) to which this depth shift applies.

CanDepthShiftBeAppliedToChildSamples.title: Can Depth Shift Be Applied To Child Samples
CanDepthShiftBeAppliedToChildSamples.description: Indicates whether the author of this depth shift intends for it to be applied to all rock samples that are subsampled from the specified SampleID. This could be used as a trigger for an application to find all child samples and apply this depth shift to those.

CanDepthShiftBeAppliedToSiblingSamples.title: Can Depth Shift Be Applied To Sibling Samples
CanDepthShiftBeAppliedToSiblingSamples.description: Indicates whether the author of this depth shift intends for it to be applied to all samples/specimens that were subsampled from the same parent sample (e.g., other core plugs taken from the same slab, but for which a depth shift data record is not explicitly generated). This could be used as a trigger for an application to find all sibling samples and apply this depth shift.

AuthorID.title: Author ID
AuthorID.description: Identifies the geoscientist, engineer, or analyst who created this depth shift.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: Free text remarks about this data

/data/Generated/work-product-component/D.title: DowntimeEvent
/data/Generated/work-product-component/D.description: A downtime event is an event that spans a discrete period that negatively affects the production or processing of hydrocarbon products (e.g. produced oil, processed diesel, etc.) at different levels of the operations (e.g. well, facility, operating unit). The event  information includes a descriptions of the event, why it occurred, etc., and free format comments that further expand on the incident. An associated record recording deferred volumes due to the event may also exist referencing this event.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name of this downtime event.

ReportingEntityID.title: Reporting Entity
ReportingEntityID.description: Reporting entity which provides the reference to the master entity the downtime event occurred at.

EventStartTime.title: Event Start Time
EventStartTime.description: The date and time the downtime event began

EventEndTime.title: Event End Time
EventEndTime.description: The date and time the downtime event ended

DowntimeComponentID.title: Downtime Component
DowntimeComponentID.description: Identifies the "Where" condition of the downtime event; i.e. which component of the system was affected? The downtime component values are further sorted into Surface and Subsurface components

DowntimeReasonID.title: Downtime Reason
DowntimeReasonID.description: Identifies the "What" condition of the downtime event; i.e. what general type of activity or issue was involved? The downtime reason codes are grouped into Planned and Unplanned categories

DowntimeReasonDetailID.title: Downtime Reason Detail
DowntimeReasonDetailID.description: Identifies the "Why" condition of the downtime event; i.e. why did it occur? These are the basic reasons for, or causes of the event

EquipmentIdentifier.title: Equipment Identifier
EquipmentIdentifier.description: The identifier of the piece of equipment that caused the downtime. This is an identifier to an external system, not an OSDU resource.

WorkOrderIdentifier.title: Work Order Identifier
WorkOrderIdentifier.description: The identifier of a work order which is associated with an event caused by a piece of equipment. This is an identifier to an external system, not an OSDU resource.

ParentDowntimeEventID.title: Parent Downtime Event
ParentDowntimeEventID.description: If there is a parent downtime event which has caused this event (e.g. a production processing facility is down, causing downtime for connected wells), then this attribute specifies the unique identifier of the entity associated with the parent event. If there is no parent event then this value is null

DownTimeTypeID.title: Down Time Type ID
DownTimeTypeID.description: Identifier of the record that specifies the loss caused by this event, or the type of the down time event is Planned, Unplanned or External.

EventStatusID.title: Event Status ID
EventStatusID.description: Identifier of the record that specifies the event status, such as is suspended'' or complete''.

/data/Generated/work-product-component/F.title: FluidModel
/data/Generated/work-product-component/F.description: A Fluid Model is a mathematical model which describes the fluid behaviour. It is often derived from sources such as laboratory fluid sample analysis. Fluid models typically contain properties that can be defined using tables (e.g. Black Oil Table), using Equation of State formulation methods, using correlations, or a combination of the above. Fluid models are frequently an input for reservoir simulation.

FluidModelTypeID.title: Fluid Model Type ID
FluidModelTypeID.description: Identifies the type of model used. Models can support one or more business contexts. E.g., for Reservoir Simulation, key types of fluid models are Black Oil, Compositional, and Thermal Compositional.

BasisOfModelling.title: Basis Of Modelling
BasisOfModelling.description: This set of attributes represents the context surrounding the processes used in running through model characterization.

InputDataCollectionID.title: Input Data Collection ID
InputDataCollectionID.description: Identifies the Persisted Collection containing relevant data used to derive this model, except for Samples Analysis, which are identified by InputSampleAnalysisIDs.

ModelPropertyFormulationMethods.title: Model Property Formulation Methods
ModelPropertyFormulationMethods.description: This provides an array of fluid model definition properties and the methodology used in estimating its property values.

items.title: Model Property Formulation Method
items.description: This captures information around the fluid model definition property and the methodology used in estimating its property values.

ModelPropertyTypeID.title: Model Property Type ID
ModelPropertyTypeID.description: Identifies the fluid model property available in the model definition. Typical properties referenced here will include phase equilibrium values, densities, water compressibilities and viscosities.

ModelPropertyFormulationMethodID.title: Model Property Formulation Method ID
ModelPropertyFormulationMethodID.description: Identifies the formulation method used in generating the numerical values assigned to the model property. E.g, Peng-Robinson

ModellingApplicationsUsed.title: Modelling Applications Used
ModellingApplicationsUsed.description: The software applications used in creating this model. For example, this could be a PVT software application that is used to create the tabular data. Best practice is to also capture the application version.

IntendedWorkflowUsageIDs.title: Intended Workflow Usage IDs
IntendedWorkflowUsageIDs.description: Identifies the subsequent business workflows for which this data is intended to be used.

IsOptimizedForEnhancedRecoveryStudies.title: Optimized For Enhanced Recovery Studies
IsOptimizedForEnhancedRecoveryStudies.description: Indicates whether or not this model is intended to be applied for enhanced recovery studies.

IsModelPvtOptimized.title: Is Model Pvt Optimized
IsModelPvtOptimized.description: Indicates whether or not this fluid model is optimized or generated from an optimized application model using required PVT data.

IsModelViscosityOptimized.title: Is Model Viscosity Optimized
IsModelViscosityOptimized.description: Indicates whether or not the fluid model is optimized or generated from an optimized application model on validated viscosity data.

IsCompositionLumped.title: Is Composition Lumped
IsCompositionLumped.description: Indicates whether or not the components described in the model are lumped, meaning the list of components has some components combined together, resulting in a more limited list as compared with the reported compositional analysis, which has the full, extended, component list. A "false" value indicates the components are not lumped, but rather extended, as found in the full compositional analysis. This is mostly applicable in Equation of State Model scenarios, with "true" being most common to support the Reservoir Simulation workflow.

ComponentCount.title: Component Count
ComponentCount.description: This provides the number of components used in characterizing the model. This is mostly applicable in Equation of State Model scenarios.

BlackOilFlashMechanismAppliedID.title: Black Oil Flash Mechanism Applied ID
BlackOilFlashMechanismAppliedID.description: Identifies the liberation or flash process that was selected as most likely to represent the depletion in the reservoir, and therefore applied to create the Black Oil model. This is only applicable for Black Oil models.

ParentModelID.title: Parent Model ID
ParentModelID.description: This is used, as a form of lineage, to explicitly indicate the fluid model OSDU record from which this fluid model was derived. Only to be used in the case that this fluid model is derived from another.

DatePublished.title: Date Published
DatePublished.description: This represents the date the model generated was published and made available to the consumers or downstream applications.

ModellingContacts.title: Modelling Contacts
ModellingContacts.description: Information about the analysts responsible for creating the model.

ModelAreaOfInterestIDs.title: Model Area Of Interest IDs
ModelAreaOfInterestIDs.description: A list of specific areas or business objects within which this model definition can be applied; E.g. Reservoir, ReservoirSegment, or Wellbore.

IsApplicableForThermalSimulation.title: Is Applicable For Thermal Simulation
IsApplicableForThermalSimulation.description: Indicates whether or not this model can be applied for simulation of thermal systems (thermodynamic systems in which the temperature of the system varies, as opposed to isothermal systems, in which the temperature remains constant).

FluidModelSaturationTypeID.title: Fluid Model Saturation Type ID
FluidModelSaturationTypeID.description: Identifies the type of saturation system the model was built for, such as a bubble point or a dew point fluid system.

HasVariableDepthFluidProperties.title: Has Variable Depth Fluid Properties
HasVariableDepthFluidProperties.description: Indicates whether or not this fluid model consists of composition or other fluid properties (implied by Fluid Model Type) that vary by depth.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: An array containing operational or quality comments pertaining to the fluid model represented by this work product component.

/data/Generated/work-product-component/G.title: GeologicUnitOccurrenceInterpretation
/data/Generated/work-product-component/G.description:
Interpretation of a sequence of geologic units actually observed (interpreted)  along or inside a representation, the representation can be 
•	1D such as a well or an arbitrary line
•	2D like a cross section
•	3D like a entire model or a group of fault blocks
It is typically based on a stratigraphic column rank but can include more units (example intrusive bodies), duplicated units (repeated sequence along a well or lines), or less units (Eroded or non-deposited).
An ordering criteria indicates the reason for the order (age, apparent depth or measured depth).

/data/Generated/work-product-component/H.title: HorizonControlPoints
/data/Generated/work-product-component/H.description: Horizon control points (seed points) representing sparse interpreter picks used to guide automated horizon tracking. Each control point captures a single depth or time pick at a spatial location. This work-product-component specializes AbstractRepresentation to deliver sparse seed points for a HorizonInterpretation. The InterpretationID links to the target HorizonInterpretation, while RepresentationRole (typically Pick) and RepresentationType (typically PointSet) characterize this representation. Control points capture key structural features, well ties, or high-confidence areas, and may serve as training labels for ML-based horizon prediction. Data may be stored inline via ColumnValues or as attached datasets such as File.TabularData.

RepresentationRole.title: Representation Role
RepresentationRole.description: The RepresentationRole assigned to these control points. For HorizonControlPoints, this is typically 'Pick' as they represent manual interpreter picks.

RepresentationType.title: Representation Type
RepresentationType.description: The RepresentationType for this representation. For HorizonControlPoints, this is typically PointSet, representing sparse spatial coordinates (seed points) used to guide automated horizon tracking algorithms.

SeismicTraceDataIDs.title: SeismicTraceDataIDs
SeismicTraceDataIDs.description: The seismic trace datasets (2D or 3D) on which the control points were interpreted. Supports multiple datasets when control points are picked across different seismic vintages or processing versions.

BinGridID.title: Bin Grid ID
BinGridID.description: Explicit 3D bin grid geometry for control points, providing spatial resolution from Inline/Crossline to X,Y coordinates. If populated and all control points are defined by Inline/Crossline, `HorizontalCRSID` is not required. If any control points use explicit X,Y coordinates instead, `HorizontalCRSID` must also be populated. Overrides bin grid from Seismic3DInterpretationSet if specified. If empty and Seismic3DInterpretationSetID is populated, bin grid is inherited from Seismic3DInterpretationSet.SeismicBinGridID

SeismicLineGeometryIDs.title: Seismic Line Geometry IDs
SeismicLineGeometryIDs.description: Explicit 2D seismic line geometries for control points, providing spatial resolution from line position to X,Y coordinates. If populated and all control points are defined by line position, `HorizontalCRSID` is not required. If any control points use explicit X,Y coordinates instead, `HorizontalCRSID` must also be populated. Overrides geometries inferred from Seismic2DInterpretationSet. If empty and Seismic2DInterpretationSetID is populated, geometries are inherited from Seismic2DInterpretationSet.SeismicLineGeometries[].

Seismic3DInterpretationSetID.title: Seismic3DInterpretationSetID
Seismic3DInterpretationSetID.description: Reference to the 3D interpretation set supporting this control point picking (not the acquisition survey or application project). The seismic bin grid geometry required to resolve spatial locations is inherited from the interpretation set. The WPC SpatialArea may reflect the survey extent where horizon control points were picked. Mutually exclusive with Seismic2DInterpretationSetID.

Seismic2DInterpretationSetID.title: Seismic2DInterpretationSetID
Seismic2DInterpretationSetID.description: Reference to the 2D interpretation set supporting this control point picking (not the acquisition survey or application project). The seismic line geometries required to resolve spatial locations are inherited from the interpretation set. The WPC SpatialArea may reflect the seismic lines where horizon control points were picked. Mutually exclusive with Seismic3DInterpretationSetID.

DomainTypeID.title: DomainTypeID
DomainTypeID.description:
Describes the domain type for the control points, for example, Depth or Time. This property is added here to be human friendly and support search use cases. This information is also captured in the `Horizon Interpretation` through the `data.DomainTypeID` property and should be 
synchronized.

HorizontalCRSID.title: Horizontal CRS ID
HorizontalCRSID.description: Horizontal coordinate reference system for X,Y coordinates in the HorizonControlPoints table. Required when control points include explicit spatial coordinates (e.g. Easting/Northing) rather than being fully resolved via BinGridID or SeismicLineGeometryIDs. If BinGridID or SeismicLineGeometryIDs are populated and all control points are defined by Inline/Crossline or line position, this property may be absent.

VerticalDatum.title: VerticalDatum
VerticalDatum.description: Defines the vertical reference datum (e.g. MSL) for the Z-values or depth/time measurements in the HorizonControlPoints table. This establishes the vertical coordinate system for all control points in this collection.

WellboreMarkerSetIDs.title: Wellbore Marker Set IDs
WellboreMarkerSetIDs.description: Optional references to WellboreMarkerSet records containing formation tops at well locations. When control points are picked at or near well locations, these marker set references enable well-tie validation and provide depth calibration data for time-depth conversion validation.

HorizonControlPoints.title: Horizon Control Points
HorizonControlPoints.description: Tabular data containing the control point locations and associated values. Each row represents a single seed point with spatial coordinates (X,Y or Inline/Crossline) and vertical datums (depth or time). Additional columns may include interpretation confidence, pick quality, source marker identifiers (e.g. linking to WellboreMarkerSet), or other attributes.

/data/Generated/work-product-component/P.title: PPFGDataset
/data/Generated/work-product-component/P.description: Pore Pressure and Fracture (Pressure) Gradient (PPFG) data describes the predicted (Pre-drill) and actual (Post-drill) depth-related variations in overburden stress, pore pressure, fracture pressure and minimum principal stress within a wellbore and conveys the range of uncertainty in these values given various plausible geological scenarios. PPFG predictions are fundamental inputs for well design and construction and estimates of pore and fracture pressure are typically provided to the well planning and execution teams.

CurveID.description: The ID of the PPFG Curve

CurveName.description: The original or as supplied PPFG curve name. Intended to hold historical or legacy information

CurveMainFamilyID.description: ID of the Main Family Type of the PPFG quantity measured, for example 'Pore Pressure'. Primarily used for high level curve classification
